عدالت نے اپنے ریمارکس میں واضح کیا کہ غیر ملکی شہریوں پر حملہ ایک قومی اور بین الاقوامی اہمیت کا حامل معاملہ ہے۔ چینی انجینئرز دو طرفہ معاہدوں کے تحت ملک میں قومی اہمیت کے منصوبوں پر کام کر رہے ہیں اور اس نوعیت کے حملوں کا مقصد غیر ملکیوں کے خلاف نفرت پھیلانا، ملک میں بدامنی پیدا کرنا اور تشدد کو ہوا دینا ہے۔ عدالت نے مفرور ملزمان کے خلاف کارروائی فی الحال التوا میں رکھنے کا بھی کہا ہے۔

stories.title: Malaysian Palm Oil Futures Secure First Weekly Gain in Three Weeks
stories.summary:
Malaysian palm oil futures closed higher, securing their first weekly increase in three weeks. The benchmark contract for January delivery on the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange rose 22 ringgit, or 0.5 percent, to settle at 4,462 ringgit ($1,093.09) per metric ton, resulting in a weekly gain of 4.79 percent.

Leading industry analysts meeting at the Indonesian Palm Oil Conference projected a price recovery in upcoming months. Production impacts stemming from an El Niño-induced drought are anticipated to affect output during the first quarter of 2027, particularly within top producer Indonesia.

Market enthusiasm was somewhat tempered by uncertainty regarding a new service fee introduced by Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia. Traders in Kuala Lumpur noted that participants are waiting for clarification on how this fee might affect the wider palm oil sector.

Palm oil prices traded in relation to broader edible oil markets, with Dalian's soyoil and palm oil contracts posting gains alongside Chicago Board of Trade soyoil futures. Additionally, a weaker Malaysian ringgit made the commodity more affordable for foreign buyers.

Crude oil futures experienced minor increases but were on track for a weekly decline. Weaker energy markets reduce the appeal of palm oil when used as a feedstock for biodiesel production.

stories.title: Islamabad High Court Suspends Local Government Elections Across Capital
stories.summary:
The Islamabad High Court suspended upcoming local government elections in the capital, placing the Election Commission of Pakistan's schedule on hold until the next hearing. Justice Umair Majeed Malik issued the interim relief during a hearing on a writ petition filed by Chaudhry Amjad Ali.

The petitioner challenged the ECP's October 21 order and election schedule for December 20, arguing that polls could not proceed until the legal status of constituency delimitations was properly resolved. The court issued notices to respondents, directing them to submit reports and comments by November 26.

Legal counsel for the petitioner argued that legislative changes between the Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Act of 2015 and the temporary Local Government Ordinance of 2026 created legal complications. The 2015 law established 125 union councils with nine wards each, whereas the 2026 ordinance introduced three town corporations and delimited union councils based on census blocks, raising the total count to 130.

After the temporary ordinance lapsed under Article 89 of the Constitution, the original 2015 law was revived. The petitioner contended that the ECP abruptly scheduled elections under the revived law without addressing required delimitations for the original union councils, wards, or metropolitan corporation structure.

The court observed that the arguments raised valid points requiring detailed consideration. Consequently, the bench halted the implementation of the election schedule and ECP order until the proceedings resume on November 26.

stories.title: Global Silver Demand Projected to Decline 5 Percent Amid High Prices
stories.summary:
Global demand for silver is on track to drop by 5 percent this year, settling at 1.08 billion troy ounces, according to a recent analysis by consultancy Metals Focus for the Silver Institute. This downturn is primarily driven by reduced spending on jewellery and lower consumption in solar cells, where soaring prices have prompted widespread material substitution. The market follows a dramatic prior year in 2025, during which prices surged to a record high of $121.60 per ounce in January before falling sharply by 59 percent to $50 an ounce.

The broader market environment has shifted due to anticipations of elevated interest rates, a stronger US dollar, and higher bond yields, all of which have cooled investment enthusiasm. Consequently, net exchange-traded product (ETP) flows have reversed, with projected outflows of 45 million ounces following massive inflows the previous year. Industrial demand overall is expected to contract by 3 percent, affected by lower-than-anticipated photovoltaic installations, particularly in China. Meanwhile, consumer segments face even steeper declines, with jewellery and silverware demand forecast to fall by 22 percent and 17 percent, respectively, exacerbated by higher costs and weakened rural spending in India.

Total supply is expected to decrease by 3 percent to 1.04 billion troy ounces, with mine production dipping slightly to 834 million ounces while recycling rises by 6 percent to 210 million ounces. The physical market balance, excluding ETP movements, is expected to show a smaller surplus of 10 million ounces compared to deep deficits in prior years. Despite these adjustments, retail interest has cooled significantly since March following the earlier price spikes, pointing to subdued bar and coin demand globally.

This contraction matters as it marks a significant cooling period for a critical industrial and precious metal following unprecedented speculative and retail rallies. The transition highlights how extreme price volatility can permanently alter industrial manufacturing choices through substitution, while broader macroeconomic shifts continue to reshape investor sentiment and market liquidity across international trading hubs.

stories.title: Islamabad Prepares to Transition into Pakistan's First Cashless City
stories.summary:
Islamabad is scheduled to become Pakistan's first fully cashless city by December 31, with all local merchants and government offices transitioning to digital payment methods. Minister of State for Interior Talal Chaudhry announced the initiative during a Friday meeting in the capital, emphasizing the necessity of stakeholder cooperation to ensure a smooth rollout. Under the new rules, cash transactions will be prohibited across all Islamabad Capital Territory (ICT) and Capital Development Authority (CDA) departments starting November 30.

To meet the end-of-year deadline for local businesses, authorities have already connected approximately 26,000 merchants to the digital system. Officials intend to extend digital payment infrastructure to all levels of commerce, ranging from major business establishments down to street vendors. This municipal push builds upon broader national efforts under the Prime Minister's Cashless Pakistan initiative, which has already seen active digital merchants nationwide quadruple to 2.03 million and total digital transaction volumes double over the past year.

Parallel discussions involving the Ministry of Finance and the State Bank of Pakistan have focused on expanding the Raast digital payment ecosystem. Measures include processing the Raast QR Merchant Discount Rate scheme, integrating QR codes onto utility bills exceeding 45 million accounts, and equipping National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) centers with digital payment capabilities. Furthermore, all payments through Asaan Assignment Accounts transitioned to the Raast system beginning November 16.

This municipal digitization serves as a pilot and accelerator for Pakistan's wider national economy, aiming to increase financial transparency and reduce reliance on physical currency. By setting strict operational deadlines for government agencies and businesses alike, the government hopes to institutionalize digital transactions as the standard across public services and commercial trade.

stories.title: Weekly Inflation Drops by 0.46 Percent Driven by Lower Fuel Prices
stories.summary:
Pakistan's weekly inflation experienced a downward adjustment of 0.46 percent for the week ending November 12, 2026, primarily due to substantial decreases in petroleum costs. According to the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, the Sensitive Price Indicator for combined consumers dropped to 372.90 points from 374.61 points the previous week, though it still reflects an 11.21 percent increase on an annual basis. The impact varied across income brackets, with the lowest-income group seeing a modest 0.03 percent increase, while higher-income brackets experienced declines ranging from 0.09 percent to 0.68 percent.

During the monitoring period, prices for 19 out of 51 tracked items rose, while 9 items decreased and 23 remained unchanged. Petrol registered the most significant week-on-week decline at 7.42 percent, closely followed by diesel dropping 6.10 percent. Additional weekly price reductions were noted for food items such as onions, bananas, gur, and sugar. Conversely, items experiencing the highest weekly increases included tomatoes up 12.06 percent, eggs up 5.98 percent, and potatoes up 2.42 percent.

When evaluated on a year-on-year basis, liquefied petroleum gas recorded the steepest surge at 111.35 percent, followed by sharp annual increases in tomatoes, quarterly electricity charges, and wheat flour. Conversely, potatoes registered the largest annual price drop at 36.41 percent, alongside notable yearly declines for sugar, eggs, and various pulses. In a separate development, the Islamabad Capital Territory Police arrested a constable for allegedly taking a bribe to help a female beggar escape custody, highlighting ongoing anti-corruption enforcement within the department.

These weekly economic figures matter because they offer an immediate gauge of cost-of-living fluctuations for ordinary citizens, heavily influenced by global commodity adjustments like petroleum. While fuel price cuts offer temporary relief to household budgets, persistent annual increases in essential food and utility items continue to present financial challenges across different income segments.

stories.title: Indian Rupee Snaps Winning Streak Amid Higher Oil and Hawkish Fed
stories.summary:
The Indian rupee halted its recent recovery path, closing lower at 94.24 against the US dollar, which marks a 0.2 percent daily decline and a 0.3 percent drop for the week. The currency's retreat was driven by rising global crude oil prices and mounting expectations that the US Federal Reserve will adopt a more aggressive monetary policy stance. These adverse external pressures counteracted the positive momentum generated by robust foreign portfolio inflows earlier in the period.

Foreign investors poured over $8 billion into Indian equities during November alone, alongside an additional $800 million into local debt markets, propelling the rupee to a six-month high prior to the late-week reversal. Market analysts note that the Reserve Bank of India has likely utilized periods of currency strength to accumulate foreign exchange reserves. Meanwhile, rising US Treasury yields—with the two-year yield hitting a one-month peak—reflect investor speculation regarding a potential 50-basis-point rate increase by the Federal Reserve next month.

The confluence of stronger US bond yields and renewed concerns over energy costs weighed heavily on domestic financial markets, pushing the benchmark Nifty 50 lower and causing the 10-year government bond yield to climb more than 6 basis points to 7.31 percent. Compounding these pressures, newly released government data revealed that India's merchandise trade deficit for October widened to a one-year high, adding fundamental strain to the currency.

This currency movement underscores India's ongoing vulnerability to shifting global macroeconomic conditions, particularly US monetary policy shifts and international energy price volatility. Despite healthy capital inflows that helped cushion the rupee from recent near-record lows, external headwinds continue to limit the scope for sustained currency appreciation.

stories.title: Indian Shares Drop as Oil Prices and Inflation Weigh Heavily
stories.summary:
Indian benchmark indices fell on Friday, reducing their weekly gains due to rising crude prices and mounting inflationary pressures that dampened investor sentiment. Despite support from foreign institutional inflows, ongoing global market turbulence and Middle East conflict headwinds impacted the nascent economic recovery.

Retail inflation for October exceeded the upper limit of the Reserve Bank of India's 2% to 6% tolerance range, raising expectations for upcoming monetary tightening. Analysts noted that higher inflation leads to increased bond yields and tighter liquidity, placing valuation pressure on rate-sensitive sectors such as banking, real estate, autos, and infrastructure.

On the session, the Nifty 50 dropped 0.61% to 25,144.3 and the Sensex declined 0.39% to 81,592.45. Financial and banking stocks fell between 0.7% and 0.8%, pulling benchmarks down. However, over the course of the week, the Nifty 50 and Sensex managed to post increases of 0.5% and 0.7%, respectively.

Equities also found backing from approximately $8 billion in foreign inflows during November, marking the highest monthly total since December 2020. Market observers warn that equities could experience near-term volatility as investors reprice policy expectations, though domestic growth and corporate earnings remain resilient.

stories.title: Pakistan Condemns Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia at UNSC Session
stories.summary:
Pakistan has strongly condemned recent Houthi terrorist attacks directed at Saudi Arabia while expressing total support for Yemen's sovereignty, independence, and territorial integrity. Speaking at a United Nations Security Council session on Friday, Ambassador Syed Haider Shah, Pakistan's Permanent Representative to the UN, demanded an immediate and unconditional halt to the aggression against the kingdom.

The diplomatic statements coincided with the UN Security Council's adoption of a resolution to renew sanctions established under resolution 2140 from 2014 and extend the mandate of the supporting Panel of Experts. Ambassador Shah praised the resolution and commended the United Kingdom for its constructive role as penholder during negotiations, emphasizing that holding accountable those who threaten Yemen's security is vital for lasting peace.

The security situation has escalated following claims by the Houthi movement that they targeted a pumping station on the Saudi East-West oil pipeline, an oil facility in Yanbu, and an Aramco building in Riyadh. The Saudi-led military coalition subsequently confirmed intercepting and destroying two drones launched by the group, one over the Riyadh region and another in the Eastern Province. Ambassador Shah reaffirmed Saudi Arabia's legitimate right to defend its territory under the UN Charter.

Pakistan and Saudi Arabia have steadily strengthened their bilateral security ties, recently signing a defense agreement in September 2025. Furthermore, in August 2026, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye established the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, a trilateral pact declaring that an assault on any member nation is considered an attack against all three allies.

stories.title: Sophie Cunningham Discusses 2026 WNBA Performance and Future Goals
stories.summary:
Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham recently discussed her 2026 WNBA season during a film session on her podcast, No Hesitation, alongside co-host and trainer Drew Hanlen. During the episode, the 28-year-old athlete described her conference as a challenging "pit" and expressed her desire to expand her offensive capabilities moving into free agency and the 2027 season.

Throughout 43 regular-season games averaging 22.2 minutes, Cunningham posted averages of 7.9 points, 2.3 rebounds, and 1.2 assists, while shooting 46.0% from the field and 41.9% from beyond the arc. Despite maintaining a reliable perimeter presence off the bench, she admitted she is unsatisfied with her current performance and wants to explore more of her potential.

Hanlen highlighted her catch-and-shoot proficiency, noting she converted 65 of 151 attempts, as a key asset that must remain a central focus. Both discussed the need for Cunningham to improve her off-ball movement, such as utilizing pin-down screens and relocating around the perimeter to generate additional scoring chances for herself and teammates like Caitlin Clark and Kelsey Mitchell.

Cunningham enters the offseason as an unrestricted free agent following a one-year contract. Refining her offensive movement and defensive intensity are viewed as crucial steps to increase her value to the Indiana Fever or another franchise for the 2027 campaign.

stories.title: Nine-Month-Old Baby Dies of Hypothermia in Flooded Gaza Tent
stories.summary:
A nine-month-old Palestinian baby named Kinan Ahmed Raqiq died of hypothermia on Thursday after severe weather and flooding struck displacement camps in the Gaza Strip. The infant's father and a treating doctor confirmed that the child succumbed to the extreme cold inside his family's tent in Khan Yunis.

The father stated that he woke up to find his son's skin had turned blue and rushed him to Nasser Hospital, where the baby was pronounced dead. Heavy rains from the previous week had already flooded tens of thousands of tents across Gaza, where nearly the entire population has faced displacement due to ongoing conflict.

UNICEF spokesperson James Elder warned that the severe flooding is merely the beginning of the cold season, noting that unprecedented rain and cold arrive weeks ahead of traditional winter weather. According to the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, storms had affected 26,000 households by November 8.

While Israel and Hamas declared a ceasefire on October 10, 2025, military strikes have continued. In response to the crisis, President Donald Trump's Board of Peace criticized Israel for failing to adequately prepare for cold weather conditions and urged authorities to permit more humanitarian supplies into the territory.

stories.title: Mari Energies Announces Copper-Gold Discovery in Balochistan's Chagai
stories.summary:
Mari Energies Limited announced a notable copper-gold discovery at its East Siah Diq exploration target in Balochistan's Chagai district, managed through its subsidiary, Mari Minerals. The company submitted a formal notification regarding the finding to the Pakistan Stock Exchange on Friday.

The discovery site is situated approximately 50 kilometers east of the Reko Diq copper-gold mine development project and 25 kilometers northwest of Nokkundi in the Koh-i-Sultan area. Mari Minerals completed roughly 25,000 meters of exploration drilling across two phases at the ESD-1 target, utilizing vertical drill holes extending down to 500 meters.

Geochemical assays from Phase 1A indicated the presence of copper-gold mineralization across intersected bedrock beneath approximately 100 meters of overburden sediments, covering an area of around 1.4 square kilometers. SGS Pakistan processed and analyzed the samples, while the company applied standard quality assurance protocols using reference materials from Australia.

Mari Energies cautioned that the find cannot yet be classified as a formal mineral resource or mineable reserve, as its true scale and economic viability will rely on further drilling and technical evaluations. Phase 1B assaying is currently underway and anticipated to finish in the first quarter of 2027.

stories.title: Islamabad Set to Become Pakistan's First Fully Cashless City by Year-End
stories.summary:
The Pakistani government has established a December 31 deadline to transition the federal capital into the country's first fully cashless city. The decision was formalized during a meeting on the Cashless Capital project chaired by State Minister for Interior Tallal Chaudry in Islamabad on Friday. Ministry officials stated that the implementation is progressing rapidly under instructions from Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi.

Under the new directives, no cash payments will be accepted across any department of the Islamabad Capital Territory administration and the Capital Development Authority after November 30. Furthermore, authorities aim to integrate all local merchants into the digital payment system by the end of December. State Minister Chaudhry noted that 26,000 merchants in Islamabad are already connected to digital payment infrastructure, which will span from street vendors to major business centers.

Officials emphasized that the transition to digital payments aims to enhance financial transparency, tax monitoring, and transaction efficiency. Capital Development Authority Chairman Sohail Ashraf and representatives from the banking sector attended the meeting, with banking officials offering full cooperation for the initiative's success. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has repeatedly highlighted the necessity of nationwide digital transaction systems to bring transparency to the broader economy.

Government authorities are actively preparing a clear roadmap and time-bound targets to establish a fully digital payments system across Pakistan. Work on digitizing payments within federal and provincial government institutions is advancing quickly, with most institutions projected to complete their transition by December 2026. The promotion of a cashless economy remains a primary objective for the current administration as part of broader financial reforms.

stories.title: National Resources Limited Discovers Copper and Gold at Eight Balochistan Sites
stories.summary:
Mining firm National Resources Limited has uncovered significant copper and gold reserves across eight locations in the Chagai district of Balochistan. The discoveries come after nearly 25,000 metres of drilling produced very promising results, paving the way for the company's initial assessment of mineral resources in the region. National Resources Limited Chairman Muhammad Ali Tabba revealed the findings during the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum 2026.

Specific findings from a drill hole detailed a 295-metre zone holding 0.43 per cent copper and 0.13 grams of gold per tonne, which included a denser 132-metre segment containing 0.83 per cent copper. These finds span a 5.6 square kilometre territory in Darigwan, connecting directly to previous finds at the Tang Kaur copper and gold location. Further evaluation under exploration licence EL214 is anticipated to clarify the total extent of the mineral deposits once work and official resource assessments conclude.

National Resources Limited operates as a joint venture among Fatima Fertilisers, Liberty Mills, and Lucky Cement Ltd, holding five distinct exploration licences in Balochistan that cover copper-gold, lead-zinc, and antimony projects. The company intends to launch environmental, hydrogeological, metallurgical, and geotechnical studies in 2027 to finalize a bankable feasibility study by the decade's end. Tabba reiterated a previously committed $100 million investment for mineral exploration in Pakistan, welcoming domestic and international stakeholders to participate.

Although an independent consultant prepared preliminary resource estimates, the company is delaying public release until international reporting requirements are fully met. Additionally, National Resources Limited has teamed up with the Lahore University of Management Sciences to build a predictive artificial intelligence model for faster exploration. Alongside technical progress, the company established the Chagai Foundation to foster education and community advancement, ensuring local populations benefit directly from regional mineral wealth.

stories.title: PTA Advises Citizens on Biometric Security and Courier Fraud
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority has issued a public warning advising citizens to exercise caution when sharing biometric information for new SIM cards and telecom services. Consumers should ensure fingerprints are given only at authorised customer service centres, franchises, or approved sales outlets of mobile network operators. Additionally, citizens are encouraged to keep a record of the network operator, outlet address, and the exact purpose of biometric collection to protect personal data from misuse.

In a separate advisory, the authority cautioned the public against a rising form of fraud involving criminals impersonating courier company representatives. These scammers contact individuals about incoming parcel deliveries and trick them into disclosing sensitive details, including one-time passwords. The PTA stressed that citizens must never share OTPs with unknown callers or unauthorized entities claiming to represent courier services or other organizations.

These public awareness initiatives are designed to help prevent identity theft, financial fraud, and the unauthorized use of citizens' sensitive information. The regulatory body continues to urge heightened vigilance across Pakistan as new methods of digital and telecom deception emerge. Consumers are reminded to verify the legitimacy of any requests for personal data before complying.

By promoting these safety measures, the PTA aims to safeguard personal privacy and reduce vulnerability to criminal schemes. Citizens can protect themselves by remaining alert and adhering strictly to official security guidelines provided by regulatory authorities.

stories.title: اسلام آباد ہائی کورٹ نے دارالحکومت میں بلدیاتی انتخابات کا شیڈول معطل کر دیا
stories.summary:
اسلام آباد ہائی کورٹ نے وفاقی دارالحکومت میں بلدیاتی انتخابات کے انعقاد کا شیڈول معطل کرتے ہوئے حکمِ امتناع جاری کر دیا ہے۔ عدالت نے اس حوالے سے الیکشن کمیشن کی جانب سے اکیس اکتوبر کو جاری کیا جانے والا نوٹی فکیشن بھی معطل کر دیا ہے۔ جسٹس عمیر مجید ملک نے حکمِ امتناع جاری کرتے ہوئے الیکشن کمیشن کو باضابطہ نوٹس جاری کر دیا ہے اور اکیس نومبر تک جواب طلب کیا ہے۔

اس فیصلے سے قبل اسلام آباد میں بلدیاتی انتخابات کے لیے کاغذاتِ نامزدگی جمع کرانے کا مرحلہ کامیابی کے ساتھ مکمل ہو چکا تھا۔ دارالحکومت میں جنرل کونسلر کی گیارہ سو پچیس نشستوں کے لیے مجموعی طور پر تین ہزار پانچ سو پانچ امیدواروں نے اپنے کاغذاتِ نامزدگی جمع کرائے تھے۔ انتخابی عمل کے لیے کل چھ ہزار پانچ سو اڑسٹھ کاغذاتِ نامزدگی جاری کیے گئے تھے، جن میں جنرل کونسلر کی نشستوں پر حصہ لینے کے لیے ایک سو دس خواتین امیدوار بھی شامل تھیں جنہوں نے اپنے کاغذات جمع کرائے۔

واضح رہے کہ اسلام آباد میں بلدیاتی اداروں کی آئینی مدت فروری دو ہزار اکیس میں ہی ختم ہو چکی تھی۔ تقریباً ساڑھے پانچ سال کے طویل انتظار کے بعد دارالحکومت میں بیس دسمبر کو پولنگ کا شیڈول طے کیا گیا تھا جس پر اب عدالتی حکم کے باعث عارضی روک لگ گئی ہے۔ اس معاملے کی آئندہ سماعت چھبیس نومبر کو ہوگی جس میں الیکشن کمیشن کو اپنا جواب جمع کرانا ہوگا۔

stories.title: پاکستان کی معدنی دولت کو کارآمد بنانا اجتماعی قومی مقصد ہے، فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر
stories.summary:
فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر نے کہا ہے کہ پاکستان کی وسیع معدنی دولت کو مؤثر طریقے سے کارآمد بنانا ہم سب کا ایک اجتماعی قومی مقصد ہے۔ اسلام آباد میں منعقدہ منرلز فورم سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ ہمارا ہدف صرف خام مال کو برآمد کرنا نہیں ہونا چاہیے، بلکہ اس کے ساتھ ساتھ ریفائننگ اور مینوفیکچرنگ تک پوری ویلیو چین کو مکمل طور پر تیار کرنا ہے۔

فیلڈ مارشل نے کہا کہ ہم اس قسم کی طویل مدتی شراکت داری کو پروان چڑھانا چاہتے ہیں جو پاکستان اور اس کے تمام شراکت داروں کے لیے پائیدار معاشی قدر پیدا کرنے کا باعث بنے۔ انہوں نے اس امر پر بھی روشنی ڈ डाली کہ معدنی ترقی کا یہ عمل ایسا ہونا چاہیے جس سے مقامی آبادیوں کو براہ راست فائدہ پہنچے، اور معدنیات سے مالا مال علاقوں کے باسیوں کی زندگیوں میں واضح اور ٹھوس بہتری نظر آنی چاہیے۔

انہوں نے پاکستانی قوم کی تعریف کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ یہاں کے لوگ انتہائی محنتی، دلیر اور پُرعزم ہیں جو اپنے خوابوں کو حقیقت میں بدلنے کی بھرپور صلاحیت رکھتے ہیں۔ ہمارے قدرتی وسائل ہمیں بہترین مواقع فراہم کرتے ہیں، جبکہ اصل نتائج کے حصول کے لیے ہمارے عوام ہی طاقت اور عزم کا اصل سرچشمہ ہیں۔

فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر نے مزید کہا کہ اب وقت آ گیا ہے کہ ہم محض صلاحیت سے نکل کر پیداوار کی طرف، وعدوں سے آگے بڑھ کر عملی اقدامات کی طرف، اور خام برآمدات کے بجائے ویلیو ایڈڈ گروتھ کی سمت قدم بڑھائیں۔ انہوں نے اس عزم کا اظہار کیا کہ کان کنی کے پورے ماحولیاتی نظام کی سیکیورٹی کو ہر صورت یقینی بنانے کے لیے مسلسل اقدامات کیے جا رہے ہیں اور آئندہ بھی جاری رہیں گے۔

stories.title: پیٹ کمنز نے عثمان خواجہ کے سینڈ پیپر سکینڈل کے دعوے کو مسترد کر دیا
stories.summary:
آسٹریلیا کے ٹیسٹ کپتان پیٹ کمنز نے عثمان خواجہ کی سوانح عمری میں کیے گئے اس دعوے کو سراسر بے بنیاد قرار دیا ہے کہ پوری آسٹریلوی ٹیم 2018 کے سینڈ پیپر سکینڈل سے آگاہ تھی۔ سڈنی میں پریس کانفرنس کرتے ہوئے کمنز نے واضح کیا کہ انہیں اس واقعے کا کوئی علم نہیں تھا اور عثمان کا یہ کہنا کہ سب جانتے تھے، سو فیصد غلط ہے۔ یہ سکینڈل 2018 میں جنوبی افریقہ کے خلاف کیپ ٹاؤن ٹیسٹ میں سامنے آیا تھا جب کیمرون بینکرافٹ کو گیند کی حالت تبدیل کرتے ہوئے پکڑا گیا تھا۔

اس واقعے کے نتیجے میں اس وقت کے کپتان اسٹیو سمتھ اور نائب کپتان ڈیوڈ وارنر کو قیادت سے ہٹایا گیا تھا اور طویل پابندیوں کا سامنا کرنا پڑا تھا، جبکہ ہیڈ کوچ ڈیرن لیہمن نے بھی استعفیٰ دے دیا تھا۔ کمنز نے کہا کہ وہ عثمان خواجہ کے دوست ہیں لیکن کتاب میں کی گئی باتیں آسٹریلوی کرکٹ اور افراد کی ساکھ کے حوالے سے غیر سنجیدہ رویے کی عکاس ہیں۔

دوسری جانب سابق آسٹریلوی اوپنر ڈیوڈ وارنر نے انسٹاگرام پر ایک ویڈیو میں عثمان خواجہ کی بھرپور حمایت کی اور دعویٰ کیا کہ اس وقت کی تحقیقات کا عمل جلد بازی اور ناقص انداز میں کیا گیا تھا۔ وارنر نے مؤقف اپنایا کہ اس معاملے میں پوری ٹیم کو اجتماعی ذمہ داری قبول کرنی چاہیے تھی۔

عثمان خواجہ نے جنوری میں اپنی بین الاقوامی کرکٹ سے ریٹائرمنٹ لی تھی اور وہ اپنے انکشافات کے بعد سے عالمی میڈیا کی توجہ کا مرکز بنے ہوئے ہیں۔ کمنز، مچل سٹارک، جوش ہیزل ووڈ اور نیتھن لیون وہ چار بولرز ہیں جو اس وقت بھی ٹیم کا حصہ ہیں اور وہ مسلسل اس منصوبے سے لاعلمی کا اظہار کرتے آئے ہیں۔

stories.title: Security Forces Neutralize 74 India-Backed Terrorists in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan
stories.summary:
Pakistani security forces have successfully eliminated at least 74 India-backed terrorists during a series of intelligence-based operations conducted across Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa provinces. According to the Inter-Services Public Relations, the military wing, these coordinated counterterrorism actions targeted militant hideouts and infrastructure in multiple volatile districts.

In the Kurram area of Quetta district, troops launched an area sanitisation operation on November 3 against militants associated with Fitna al-Khawarij and Fitna al-Hindustan. Following intense engagements, security forces neutralized 31 insurgents and recovered significant caches of weapons, ammunition, and explosives from their hideouts.

Concurrently, operations were expanded into the Mir Ali and Orakzai regions of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa over a 48-hour period. Fierce exchanges of fire resulted in the deaths of 35 terrorists in Mir Ali and 8 in Orakzai. Troops also seized large quantities of homemade explosives and improvised explosive devices, preempting planned attacks.

The military stated that sanitisation efforts remain ongoing to clear out remaining elements. These actions are part of the broader Azm-e-Istehkam counterterrorism campaign aimed at eradicating foreign-sponsored violence, which has heavily concentrated in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan since 2021.

stories.title: Sophie Cunningham Recalls Stephen A. Smith's Lakers Remarks
stories.summary:
WNBA player Sophie Cunningham recently addressed the Los Angeles Lakers' impressive start to the 2026-27 NBA season while criticizing skeptics and ESPN commentator Stephen A. Smith. Discussing the team's early success, Cunningham recalled a past podcast interview with NBA trainer Drew Hanlen and referenced an old segment by Smith questioning whether a team built around white players could win a championship.

Cunningham expressed amusement at the initial doubts surrounding the roster, noting that the Lakers have effectively silenced critics with their strong on-court performance. As an acknowledged fan of Slovenian star Luka Dončić, she praised his prolific scoring and high-level play, which has elevated the team near the top of the Western Conference standings.

Reflecting on the competitive mindset of professional athletes, Cunningham emphasized that high-level competitors thrive when told they cannot succeed, using outside doubt as fuel to prove detractors wrong. The Lakers' strong early run has positioned them as formidable contenders in the current NBA season.

Despite past skepticism from analysts regarding roster construction, the team's recent victories have validated their competitive potential. Cunningham's remarks highlight the ongoing narrative surrounding the franchise's surprising and dominant start to the year.

stories.title: Beardman and Marsh Drive Australia to Victory Over England
stories.summary:
Mahli Beardman recorded remarkable debut figures of 6-24 before Mitchell Marsh scored a rapid half-century to lead Australia to a seven-wicket win over England in the first ODI at Perth Stadium on Friday. After Marsh won the toss and elected to bowl, 21-year-old Beardman tore through the England batting lineup, causing the visitors to collapse and get bowled out for 131 in 33.4 overs.

England openers Ben Duckett and Tom Banton advanced the score to 24 before Duckett edged Spencer Johnson to slip, triggering a collapse of 7-41. Aside from a brief partnership featuring Will Jacks and an unbeaten 29 from Gus Atkinson, the English batsmen struggled against the seam and swing of Beardman and Johnson, with Johnson finishing with 3-42.

Chasing the modest target, Australia suffered an early setback when Atkinson bowled Travis Head with the first ball of the innings. However, Marsh launched an aggressive counterattack, striking a 29-ball fifty that included four boundaries and four sixes to secure the victory alongside contributions from Cooper Connolly, Josh Inglis, and Matt Renshaw.

England captain Harry Brook acknowledged that his team failed to execute their skills effectively on the drop-in pitch at Optus Stadium. The three-match series will continue on Sunday with the second fixture scheduled in Adelaide.

stories.title: Pat Cummins Denies Knowledge of 2018 Ball-Tampering Plot
stories.summary:
Australian cricket captain Pat Cummins stated that Usman Khawaja was completely wrong in his new autobiography by claiming the entire team knew about the 2018 ball-tampering scandal in South Africa. The controversy resurfaced after Khawaja alleged in his book that players, including Cummins, were aware of the plan to use sandpaper on the ball during the Cape Town Test and a previous match in Port Elizabeth.

David Warner strongly supported Khawaja's version of events and criticized Cummins for throwing Khawaja under the bus during a lengthy press conference. Cummins firmly denied any prior knowledge of the sandpaper plot, reiterating public denials he and fellow bowlers Mitchell Starc, Josh Hazlewood, and Nathan Lyon previously made in 2021. Former coach Darren Lehmann and batting coach Graeme Hick also denied knowing about the incident.

Cummins expressed disappointment that Khawaja raised the allegations casually eight years later, arguing that the claims damage reputations and affect Australian cricket broadly. While Cummins disputed Khawaja's claim about a dressing-room conversation urging collective responsibility, he admitted that the team culture in 2018 featured an unwanted win-at-all-costs mentality that he has since worked to change.

Cricket Australia has confirmed it will not reopen an investigation into the matter, and chairman David Boon assured Cummins that his position as captain remains secure. Meanwhile, Warner vowed to continue speaking out until what he considers the complete truth comes to light.

stories.title: Detention Order of PTI Lahore President Mian Usman Akram Withdrawn
stories.summary:
The deputy commissioner of Lahore, Capt. (Retd.) Muhammad Ali Ijaz, has withdrawn the detention order for Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) Lahore President Mian Usman Akram. This update was officially communicated through a report submitted to the Lahore High Court by a representative of the deputy commissioner. Justice Ali Zia Bajwa is set to hear the petition that initially challenged the detention, which was filed by Usman's wife, Kulsoom Usman, to secure his release. 

Mian Usman Akram had been held in jail for the past two months under Section 3 of the Maintenance of Public Order (MPO) Ordinance. His release follows closely behind the liberation of Noreen Khan Niazi and Uzma Khan, sisters of PTI founder Imran Khan, who were released from Kot Lakhpat Jail a day prior. The two sisters had been detained since September 21 under the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance of 1960, also by order of the Lahore deputy commissioner. 

During her detention, Noreen Niazi had experienced health complications on October 29. According to her lawyer, Rana Mudassar Umar, she was transferred from prison to the Punjab Institute of Cardiology after reporting chest pain, where she underwent initial medical examinations. 

Separately, the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) issued a public awareness message advising citizens to remain vigilant regarding their biometric data. The authority cautioned consumers to ensure that their fingerprints for acquiring new SIM cards or telecommunication services are only submitted at authorized customer service centers, franchises, or approved sales outlets.

stories.title: Australia Crushes England in Opening ODI After Mahli Beardman's Debut
stories.summary:
Australia secured a dominant seven-wicket victory over England in the first ODI of the three-match series in Perth on Friday. After Australian captain Mitchell Marsh won the toss and elected to bowl, 21-year-old debutant Mahli Beardman recorded the best ODI bowling figures by an Australian on debut, taking 6-24. Beardman tore through England's upper order with pace and aggression, while left-armer Spencer Johnson supported with 3-42 as the visitors were bowled out for 131 in 33.4 overs. 

England's innings began with openers Ben Duckett and Tom Banton reaching 24 runs before a collapse saw them lose 7-41. Gus Atkinson top-scored for England with an unbeaten 29 off 32 balls, aided by Will Jacks who contributed 25 runs, helping the team avoid a total score below 100. England captain Harry Brook noted that his team failed to properly execute their skills or adapt to the drop-in pitch at Optus Stadium against a disciplined Australian bowling attack. 

In response, Australia suffered an immediate setback when Atkinson bowled Travis Head with the first ball of the innings. However, Mitchell Marsh quickly shifted momentum by smashing an unbeaten 50 off 29 balls, featuring four boundaries and four sixes. Cooper Connolly added 27 runs, while Josh Inglis with 23 and Matt Renshaw with 26 successfully guided Australia to the target. 

The low-key start to the series took place amidst significant media attention surrounding the Sandpapergate ball-tampering scandal, which was reignited by the launch of former Australian opener Usman Khawaja’s autobiography. The two teams are scheduled to travel to Adelaide for the second match of the series on Sunday. 

In an unrelated public announcement, the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) urged citizens to exercise caution when providing fingerprints for new SIM cards and telecom services. The authority advised that biometric information should only be shared at authorized customer service centers, franchises, or approved sales outlets.

stories.title: Matt Henry and Will Young Lead New Zealand to 244-Run Victory
stories.summary:
New Zealand secured a commanding 244-run victory over India in the fourth ODI at Mount Maunganui on Friday, narrowing India's series lead to 2-1 with one match remaining. Fast bowler Matt Henry delivered a devastating opening over, dismissing Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, and Shreyas Iyer all for ducks. Henry finished with a career-best 6-27 as the visitors were bowled out for a meager 89 while chasing a target of 334.

After being asked to bat first, New Zealand posted 333 all out in the final over. Opener Will Young capitalized on two early dropped catches to score his fifth ODI century, compiling 125 runs from 108 deliveries with 14 fours and four sixes. Young shared an 85-run opening stand with Tim Seifert, who contributed a quick-fire 58 off 39 balls, and later added 90 runs with Finn Allen, who made 41.

India's run chase collapsed immediately following Henry's stellar spell, leaving Ishan Kishan as the top scorer with just 27 runs. Indian captain Iyer acknowledged the tough batting conditions and noted that his team tried almost everything during the bowling innings, where Axar Patel, Auqib Nabi, and Gurnoor Brar each claimed two wickets.

Henry's performance marked a strong return to the Black Caps after he missed the first three games due to a concussion sustained from a training ground head clash with Devon Conway. Reflecting on his spell, Henry attributed his success to keeping things simple amid strong winds and utilizing the movement available in the first over. The final match of the series is scheduled for this Sunday.

stories.title: Babar Azam Falls for 34 as Pakistan Reaches 151-5 at Lunch
stories.summary:
Pakistan captain Babar Azam's century drought extended during the weather-interrupted first Test against Sri Lanka at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium on Friday. Reaching lunch on the fifth and final day, Pakistan stood at 151-5 with a lead of 139 runs and five wickets remaining. Saud Shakeel was unbeaten on 23 alongside Ghazi Ghori on seven runs, following a brief twenty-minute halt caused by bad light that temporarily paused Sri Lanka's pursuit of a 1-0 series lead. 

Babar was dismissed for 34 runs after falling into a leg-side trap, offering a straightforward catch to the short square-leg fielder off fast bowler Milan Rathnayaka. This marked Babar's 42nd consecutive Test innings without reaching a century. Shortly after, Salman Ali Agha fell in an identical manner to Rathnayaka for 13 runs, dropping Pakistan deeper into trouble at 125-5. 

The morning session began poorly for the hosts when Sri Lanka struck on the very first ball of the day, with Lahiru Kumara dismissing Azan Awais for 22 with the overnight total at 57. In the following over, Asitha Fernando removed Mohammad Taha caught behind for 24, reducing Pakistan to 57-3. Babar had previously been dropped on 22 by Kamindu Mendis off Fernando before eventually hitting six fours and sharing a 50-run fourth-wicket partnership with Saud Shakeel prior to his dismissal.

stories.title: Analyzing How Energy Shocks and Oil Prices Influence US Dollar Strength
stories.summary:
The relationship between oil prices and the US dollar involves complex interactions across global trade, inflation, monetary policy, and risk sentiment. Rather than assuming crude prices automatically dictate a stronger or weaker dollar, market analysts examine what drives oil movements and how those same shocks affect interest-rate expectations and bond yields. Because crude benchmarks like Brent and WTI are priced in US dollars, currency fluctuations directly impact energy costs for international buyers.

Supply disruptions can trigger a broader chain reaction by increasing headline, transportation, and production inflation. If markets anticipate that central banks will maintain restrictive monetary policies to counter these pressures, US interest-rate and Treasury yield expectations can rise, subsequently strengthening the dollar. Additionally, major geopolitical disruptions often prompt investors to seek liquid, dollar-denominated assets while simultaneously pressuring the currencies of energy-importing economies.

However, this dynamic can shift if an energy shock becomes severe enough to threaten global or US economic growth. In such scenarios, market focus may pivot toward recession risks and potential monetary easing, which can drive Treasury yields lower and weaken the dollar even while oil prices remain elevated. Historical data illustrates these currency effects; for instance, between June 2021 and May 2022, Brent crude rose 59 percent in US dollar terms but surged 86 percent in euros due to a stronger dollar.

To accurately assess market conditions during sharp commodity moves, analysts monitor multiple indicators simultaneously rather than relying solely on crude. Cross-asset analysis utilizing the DXY index, major foreign exchange pairs like EURUSD, US Treasury yields, inflation expectations, and equity risk sentiment helps determine whether dollar strength reinforces or offsets commodity price movements.

stories.title: Karachi JIT to Decide Fate of Business Partner Ahmed Bhardey Today
stories.summary:
A Joint Investigation Team in Karachi is scheduled to decide whether to release Ahmed Bhardey, the business partner of Mir Raza Ali, or to seek his physical remand in connection with an ongoing case. Investigation sources indicate that Bhardey is currently being held at the Taimuria Police Station and will be produced before the JIT for further legal proceedings.

Bhardey's interactions with law enforcement have involved multiple summons over the preceding days. Authorities initially called him in at midnight on Saturday before releasing him at 5 am, followed by subsequent questioning periods spanning Sunday, Monday, and Tuesday evenings. On Wednesday, investigators summoned him to the Sir Syed Police Station and accompanied him to a restaurant in Nazimabad from 6 pm to 9 pm before permitting him to return home late at night.

On Thursday, Bhardey was directed to report to the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency office in the afternoon before being transferred to the Taimuria Police Station by evening. Investigation officials stated that the JIT is proceeding swiftly with the case to determine whether to grant him a release or pursue remand.

The investigation follows prior developments in the Mir Raza case, which included the JIT sealing a restaurant belonging to Bhardey. Authorities continue to review evidence and coordinate actions across various police and federal agency offices as the inquiry progresses.

stories.title: Mari Energies Announces Major Copper-Gold Discovery in Balochistan's Chagai District
stories.summary:
Mari Energies Limited announced a significant copper-gold discovery at its East Siah Diq target in the Chagai district of Balochistan. The find was made by its wholly owned subsidiary, Mari Minerals, and disclosed through a formal notice to the Pakistan Stock Exchange on Friday.

The discovery site is located approximately 50 kilometers east of the Reko Diq copper-gold mine development project and 25 kilometers northwest of Nokkundi in the Koh-i-Sultan area, adjacent to the Siah Diq Project. Mari Minerals holds multiple exploration licenses in the Chagai region and has completed about 25,000 meters of exploration drilling across two phases at the ESD-1 target, confirming it as a new porphyry copper discovery.

Further technical evaluations, including additional drilling, geological interpretation, metallurgical testing, and resource estimation, remain necessary to establish the scale, grade continuity, economic significance, and overall development potential of the mineral deposits. John Mortimer of JM Geoscience Pty Ltd, an expert with over 40 years of experience in porphyry copper exploration, reviewed and approved the technical information.

Mari Minerals was established in July 2023 under Mari Energies Limited to undertake mineral mining projects in Pakistan. This announcement follows a recent agreement between Mari Minerals and mining giant Ivanhoe Atlantic to jointly explore copper and gold deposits and identify development opportunities within the region.

stories.title: Italy Defeats France 3-1 to Hand Zinedine Zidane First Loss
stories.summary:
Francesco Pio Esposito scored twice to lead Italy to a 3-1 comeback victory over France at San Siro on Thursday, handing Zinedine Zidane his first defeat as France head coach. The win propelled Italy to the top of Nations League Group A1 with 10 points, level with France but holding the advantage on head-to-head records. Belgium sit third in the group with nine points following a win over Turkey. 

France opened the scoring in the 10th minute after Italian goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma passed directly to Michael Olise, who maneuvered past a defender to net his fifth goal of the campaign. Despite missing injured star attackers Kylian Mbappe and Ousmane Dembele, France controlled early proceedings under heavy rain. Italy equalized in the 26th minute when Nicolo Cambiaghi drove to the byline and provided a cross for Esposito to convert with a deft touch. 

Both teams hit the woodwork multiple times throughout the entertaining match, with Bradley Barcola and Rayan Cherki striking the frame for France. Italy squandered an opportunity to take the lead just before the hour mark when Sebastiano Esposito missed a penalty kick following a foul on Cambiaghi by Malo Gusto. However, Italy quickly atoned when substitute Davide Frattesi scored from a Federico Dimarco cross in the 63rd minute. 

Securing the result, Antonio Vergara earned a second penalty for the hosts after being fouled by Dayot Upamecano. Francesco Pio Esposito stepped up this time, drilling his shot into the bottom corner. The victory marks a strong beginning to Roberto Mancini's second tenure as Italy coach, extending their unbeaten streak to four matches and sealing their first home win against France since 1962.

stories.title: پاکستان کو ماحولیاتی تبدیلی سے نمٹنے کے لیے مزید قرضوں کے بجائے مالی امداد دی جائے، شیری رحمٰن
stories.summary:
پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی کی نائب صدر سینیٹر شیری رحمٰن نے کہا ہے کہ پاکستان کو ماحولیاتی تبدیلی کے چیلنجز سے مؤثر طریقے سے نمٹنے کے لیے مزید قرضے دینے کے بجائے مالی امداد دی جائے اور موجودہ قرضوں میں ریلیف فراہم کیا جائے۔ اس وقت وہ وزیرِ اعظم شہباز شریف کے ہمراہ ترکیہ میں منعقد ہونے والی کوپ اکتیس کانفرنس میں شریک ہیں۔

ایک جاری کردہ بیان میں انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ اس عالمی کانفرنس میں محض زبانی وعدے نہیں ہونے چاہئیں بلکہ ماحولیاتی انصاف اور ان تمام ممالک کے لیے عملی اقدامات ناگزیر ہیں جو اس بحران سے سب سے زیادہ متاثر ہوئے ہیں۔ انہوں نے یاد دلایا کہ دو ہزار بائیس کے تباہ کن سیلاب کی وجہ سے پاکستان میں تین کروڑ تیس لاکھ افراد براہ راست متاثر ہوئے تھے اور ملک کو تیس ارب ڈالرز کا مالی نقصان اٹھانا پڑا تھا۔

پی پی پی رہنما نے زور دیا کہ دنیا بھر میں فوسل فیول پر دی جانے والی سالانہ سات ہزار ارب ڈالرز کی سبسڈی کو ماحولیاتی تحفظ کے کاموں پر خرچ کیا جانا چاہیے۔ موجودہ پالیسیوں کے تحت عالمی درجہ حرارت میں دو عشاریہ سات ڈگری سینٹی گریড تک اضافے کا سنگین خدشہ موجود ہے۔ انہوں نے بتایا کہ پاکستان کو اپنے ماحولیاتی اہداف حاصل کرنے کے لیے پانچ سو پینسٹھ ارب ڈالرز سے زائد کی ضرورت ہے، جبکہ پاکستان نے لاس اینڈ ڈیمیج فنڈ سے تقریباً اٹھاون ملین ڈالرز کی باضابطہ درخواست جمع کرا رکھی ہے۔

شیری رحمٰن نے کہا کہ ماحولیاتی آفات کی وجہ سے مصائب کا شکار ہونے والے افراد تک مالی امداد فوری طور پر پہنچنی چاہیے، اور اس کے علاوہ ماحولیات کے تحفظ، زراعت، پانی اور بنیادی ڈھانچے کی حفاظت کے لیے بڑی سرمایہ کاری انتہائی ضروری ہے۔ انہوں نے اس بات کا اعادہ کیا کہ پاکستان کسی قسم کی خیرات کا طلبگار نہیں ہے بلکہ دنیا سے ماحولیاتی انصاف اور مالی ذمے داری کا مطالبہ کر رہا ہے۔

stories.title: صدر زرداری اور محسن نقوی کی ملاقات پر قیاس آرائیاں مناسب نہیں: ناصر شاہ
stories.summary:
سندھ کے وزیرِ بلدیات ناصر حسین شاہ نے کہا ہے کہ صدر آصف علی زرداری اور وزیرِ داخلہ محسن نقوی کے درمیان ملاقات کو سیاسی رنگ دینا یا اس پر قیاس آرائیاں کرنا درست نہیں ہے۔ کراچی میں میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ دونوں شخصیات کے درمیان تعلقات ذاتی نوعیت کے ہیں اور یہ ملاقات کسی صوبے یا دیگر سیاسی امور پر نہیں بلکہ ذاتی بنیادوں پر ہوئی تھی۔

ناصر شاہ کا کہنا تھا کہ صدر زرداری، بلاول بھٹو زرداری اور وزیرِ اعلیٰ سندھ آئین کی بالادستی پر یقین رکھتے ہیں اور نئے صوبوں کے معاملے پر سندھ اسمبلی اور عوام اپنا واضح فیصلہ دے چکے ہیں۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ اگر کوئی نیا صوبہ بنانا چاہتا ہے تو اس کے لیے آئین میں طریقہ کار موجود ہے جس کے تحت صوبائی اسمبلی سے دو تہائی اکثریت سے بل پاس کروانا ہوتا ہے اور اس پر انہیں کوئی اعتراض نہیں ہے۔

پیپلز پارٹی کے رہنما نے یہ بھی کہا کہ بلاول بھٹو کو وزیرِ اعظم سے ملاقات کے لیے کسی سفارش کی ضرورت نہیں ہے۔ انہوں نے متحدہ قومی موومنٹ (ایم کیو ایم) کے حوالے سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ وہ ان کے اندرونی مسائل پر ہمدردی رکھتے ہیں اور انہیں سنجیدہ نہیں لیتے۔

اس کے علاوہ پریس کانفرنس کے دوران انہوں نے وفاقی آئینی عدالت کی تقریب، کراچی میں پانی کی فراہمی کے نظام، اور مختلف قانونی و انتظامی امور پر بھی ہلکا پھلکا تبصرہ کیا۔ حکومت کے مشیر برائے سیاسی امور رانا ثناء اللہ نے بھی اس بات کی تردید کی ہے کہ یہ ملاقات کسی آئینی ترمیم کے لیے کروائی گئی تھی۔

stories.title: Matt Henry takes six wickets as New Zealand crushes India by 244 runs
stories.summary:
New Zealand defeated India by 244 runs in the fourth One-Day International at Mount Maunganui on Friday, taking a commanding victory in the match. Fast bowler Matt Henry delivered a devastating opening over, dismissing Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, and Shreyas Iyer all without scoring as India began their pursuit of a 334-run target. India failed to recover from the early collapse, with Ishan Kishan scoring a team-high 27 runs before the visitors were bowled out for just 89 in 0 overs.

Henry finished with exceptional bowling figures of 6-27, while teammate Matthew Fisher claimed 31 runs for three wickets. Earlier in the match, New Zealand posted a total of 333 all out in the final over after being asked to bat first. Will Young anchored the innings by scoring 125 runs from 108 deliveries, recording his fifth ODI century despite being dropped twice early in his knock. Young shared an 85-run opening stand with Tim Seifert, who contributed a quick 58 runs from 39 balls.

Young found further support through a 90-run partnership with Finn Allen, who added 41 runs off 30 balls before being dismissed. Indian bowlers Axar Patel, Auqib Nabi, and Gurnoor Brar each claimed two wickets apiece, but the hosts maintained control throughout the contest. With this result, India holds a 2-1 lead in the five-match series, with the final fixture scheduled for Sunday at the same venue in Mount Maunganui.

stories.title: Pakistan prioritizes strategic minerals to attract global investors, says Ali Pervaiz Malik
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum continued in Islamabad, where the government highlighted its commitment to enhancing the country's mineral sector and drawing international investment. Minister for Petroleum Ali Pervaiz Malik told attendees that ongoing government initiatives are heavily concentrated on minerals that hold strategic value for global investors. These efforts are reinforced by modern geophysical and geochemical surveys to boost exploration capabilities across the nation.

The minister stated that the Geological Survey of Pakistan is actively strengthening the scientific base of the sector, supported by developing expertise in digital mapping, airborne surveys, and mineral assessment. Malik emphasized that the administration aims to establish uniform fiscal terms for all participating companies, removing the need for special arrangements to create a fair framework for investors, provinces, and the federal government. Security measures have also been introduced to protect mining sites, logistical operations, and trained personnel, ensuring uninterrupted operations in a secure environment.

Highlighting recent developments, Malik pointed to newly issued mineral exploration licenses in Balochistan's Chagai and Khuzdar districts as part of an expansion in exploration activities. At the same event, Barrick Mining Corporation Chairman John Thornton spoke about the Reko Diq project, describing it as a collaborative partnership involving Pakistan, Barrick, local communities, and international investors to develop a major global mineral resource. Meanwhile, the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority issued a public warning urging citizens to practice biometric caution exclusively at authorized centers when obtaining new SIM cards.

stories.title: ASEAN faces internal divisions over easing its diplomatic ban on Myanmar's military leadership
stories.summary:
The Association of Southeast Asian Nations faces mounting pressure ahead of its upcoming summit in Manila to reconsider a five-year ban preventing Myanmar's military-backed leaders from attending high-level meetings. Myanmar has experienced severe civil conflict resulting in over 100,000 deaths since former military chief Min Aung Hlaing ousted the elected government in a 2021 coup. The nation's leadership has been barred from regional gatherings due to its failure to enact the Five-Point Consensus, a peace framework established following the military takeover.

Despite the official exclusion, nearly half of ASEAN's 11 member states have increased bilateral engagement with Myanmar following elections held in December and January, which were won by the military-backed Union Solidarity and Development Party. Leaders from Laos, Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, and Malaysia have hosted Min Aung Hlaing for official visits this year, with Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim expressing support for Myanmar's eventual reintegration. Thailand is actively advocating to ease restrictions and allow Myanmar's foreign minister to participate in bloc meetings, with Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow suggesting progress could permit a decision by Thailand's chairmanship in 2028 at the latest.

While nations like Thailand engage Myanmar to manage border security, trade, and migration issues, analysts note that these shifting dynamics challenge the original Five-Point Consensus and test regional unity. Human Rights Watch has urged ASEAN to maintain restrictions and pressure the military regime toward civilian rule, while other diplomats advocate for pragmatic, conditional steps like securing regular access to detained civilian leader Aung San Suu Kyi. ASEAN leaders are set to review the implementation of the peace plan and the bloc's diplomatic stance during the summit taking place from November 15 to November 17.

stories.title: European shares decline from record highs amid market uncertainty over artificial intelligence
stories.summary:
European stock markets opened lower, retreating from record highs reached in the previous session, as uncertainty surrounding the artificial intelligence trade rippled globally following the sudden resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Investors expressed concern over the future trajectory of AI development and the financing web that has supported the booming sector, given Huang's prominent role as a key personality in the industry. The unexpected departure followed revelations regarding Huang's extramarital affairs.

By 0808 GMT, the STOXX 600 index fell 0.2% to 662.64 points, led by a 1% decline in personal and household goods. Despite the daily dip, Goldman Sachs raised its 12-month target for the STOXX 600 from 695 to 700 points. European equities have recently been buoyed by robust corporate earnings this quarter, and because Europe features smaller exposure to AI-linked stocks, the index reached record levels for the first time since August, maintaining a weekly gain of over 2% for its strongest weekly performance since June.

Technology and chip-related stocks experienced downward pressure during the session, with companies such as Siltronic and Aixtron dropping over 1% each. AI equipment makers including Schneider Electric and Legrand saw marginal decreases, contributing to a 0.6% loss for the broader tech sector. Additionally, corporate earnings reports impacted individual equities, as Cartier owner Richemont saw its shares fall 7% after reporting a 13% increase in sales for the three months ending in September, marking a slowdown from the 20% growth rate recorded in the prior quarter.

stories.title: Asean faces pressure over Myanmar ban ahead of Manila summit
stories.summary:
The Association of Southeast Asian Nations is encountering mounting pressure to relax a five-year prohibition keeping Myanmar’s military-backed leaders from attending top-level gatherings. Leaders from the bloc are scheduled to evaluate this exclusion policy during meetings in Manila taking place from November 15 to November 17.

Myanmar has experienced profound turmoil following a 2011 coup led by Min Aung Hlaing that removed the elected government and triggered a civil war resulting in over 100,000 deaths. Its leadership has stayed barred from summits because of a failure to enact the Five-Point Consensus peace plan. Nevertheless, nearly half of the bloc's eleven members, including Thailand, Laos, Vietnam, Cambodia, and Malaysia, have engaged in bilateral visits with Min Aung Hlaing following recent elections.

Thailand is actively pushing for restrictions to be lifted so that Myanmar's foreign minister can participate in ministerial sessions. Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow expressed hope that progress would enable a decision by Thailand's chairmanship in 2028 at the latest. Meanwhile, analysts and diplomats indicate that differing member approaches challenge the existing consensus, with countries like Singapore and various human rights organizations advocating for strict conditions before granting political acceptance.

The upcoming summit will feature a negotiated document reviewing the implementation of the peace framework, according to Philippine spokesperson Dominic Xavier Imperial. While nations like Thailand emphasize trade, security, and border stability to justify renewed engagement, other voices within the bloc urge adherence to standards involving humanitarian aid, the cessation of violence, and the release of political prisoners, including detained civilian leader Aung San Suu Kyi.

stories.title: National Resources Limited identifies copper and gold across Chagai district
stories.summary:
National Resources Limited has located copper and gold mineralisation across at least eight porphyry discoveries situated in Balochistan’s Chagai district. Chairman Muhammad Ali Tabba revealed the findings at the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum 2026, noting that roughly 25,000 metres of drilling produced positive results as the firm moves toward its initial mineral resource estimate.

One specific drill hole yielded 295 metres of continuous mineralisation featuring grades of 0.43% copper and 0.13 grams per tonne of gold, which included a 132-metre section grading 0.83% copper. These discoveries cover a 5.6 square kilometre area in Darigwan, near the company's prior find at the Tang Kaur copper-gold porphyry system. Additional work on exploration licence EL214 is anticipated to confirm significant resources upon completion of formal resource estimation.

Operated as a joint venture between Fatima Fertilisers, Liberty Mills, and Lucky Cement Ltd, NRL holds five exploration licences in Balochistan across multiple resource projects. The enterprise intends to launch environmental, hydrogeological, metallurgical, and geotechnical studies in 2027 to establish a bankable feasibility study by the decade's end. Tabba reaffirmed a previously stated $100 million commitment to mineral exploration within Pakistan.

Furthermore, NRL is developing a predictive artificial intelligence model alongside the Lahore University of Management Sciences to boost exploration speed. The company employs an almost entirely indigenous technical workforce, aiming to foster domestic capabilities that can eventually support international exploration endeavors.

stories.title: Sindh government plans gradual transition of official fleet to electric vehicles
stories.summary:
The Sindh government has resolved to progressively convert vehicles utilized by provincial departments into electric vehicles to lower public spending, conserve fuel, and encourage green transportation methods. The decision emerged during a Cabinet Committee on Austerity session headed by Sindh Senior Minister Sharjeel Inam Memon in Karachi on Friday.

Sharjeel Memon stated that safeguarding public resources is a foremost priority for the administration, aiming to reduce government outlays while protecting the environment. Under the new policy, electric vehicles will receive priority when acquiring new transport for official departments. The gathering specifically sanctioned the procurement of new automobiles designated for the Home Department, the Anti-Corruption Establishment, and the Universities and Boards Department.

Implementing electric vehicles across public institutions aims to alleviate financial burdens related to fuel expenses on the provincial treasury and cut day-to-day operational costs. Local Government Minister Nasir Hussain Shah noted that emissions from traditional automobiles negatively impact urban air quality and mentioned that similar promotion efforts are underway within local government bodies.

stories.title: Pakistan Struggles at 151-5 Against Sri Lanka Amid Babar Azam's Drought
stories.summary:
Babar Azam's long-standing failure to score a Test century persisted on Friday as Sri Lanka exerted strong pressure during the weather-interrupted opening Test in Rawalpindi. By lunch on the fifth and final day, the batting side found themselves at 151-5, holding a narrow lead of 139 runs with five wickets remaining.

Morning play was heavily affected by poor visibility, resulting in four wickets falling and a brief twenty-minute halt. Azam managed 34 runs before falling to a leg-side trap off fast bowler Milan Rathnayaka, marking his forty-second consecutive innings without reaching a Test century. Salman Agha was dismissed in an identical manner by the same bowler for 13.

The morning session had begun poorly when Lahiru Kumara removed overnight batter Azan Awais for 22 on the team's overnight score of 57. In the following over, Asitha Fernando bowled Mohammad Taha for 24, reducing the batting side to 57-3. Azam had previously been dropped on 22 by Kamindu Mendis off Fernando's bowling.

Despite hitting six boundaries and putting together a fifty-run partnership for the fourth wicket alongside Saud Shakeel, Azam ultimately played a loose stroke. At the lunch break, Shakeel remained undefeated on 23 alongside Ghazi Ghori, who was on seven, as the visiting team sought a 1-0 lead in the two-match series.

stories.title: Tyga and Madelaine Petsch Call It Quits After Dating Over a Year
stories.summary:
Celebrity couple Tyga and Madelaine Petsch have reportedly broken up after spending more than a year together, according to multiple individuals who confirmed the separation to PEOPLE. The 36-year-old rapper and the 32-year-old Riverdale actress initially sparked speculation about a romance in February 2025 when they were spotted sitting courtside at a Los Angeles Lakers game, though neither star ever made a formal public confirmation.

The reported breakup arrives just two months after the duo was seen enjoying an affectionate outing at Knott’s Scary Farm in Southern California. Back in September, an insider mentioned that they appeared very happy together and noted that Petsch had been spending time with the rapper's 13-year-old son, King Cairo, whom he shares with his former partner Blac Chyna.

Throughout the duration of their rumored romance, the pair made several public appearances together, including attending a gathering at Bar Marmont and stepping out at the Vanity Fair and Instagram Vanities Party in February 2025. Despite these public outings, Petsch has historically maintained a guarded approach regarding her personal life and romantic relationships.

In a previous appearance on the Call Her Daddy podcast hosted by Alex Cooper, the actress spoke about the difficulties of balancing public and private spheres after spending a decade in the public eye. During the interview, she also outlined the key traits she looks for in a significant other, emphasizing the importance of kindness, consistency, trust, and open communication.

stories.title: خواتین میں زچگی کے بعد طویل المعمر طبی پیچیدگیاں اور ان کے اثرات
stories.summary:
بچے کی پیدائش کا عمل بظاہر ماں اور بچے دونوں کے لیے خطرناک ہو سکتا ہے، تاہم زچگی کے بعد پیدا ہونے والے وہ دیرپا جسمانی مسائل جو ابتدائی برسوں سے آگے بھی برقرار رہتے ہیں، اکثر کم توجہ کا مرکز بنتے ہیں۔ دنیا بھر میں ہر سال تقریباً چار کروڑ خواتین ایسی طبی پیچیدگیوں سے متاثر ہوتی ہیں جو مہینوں یا برسوں تک جاری رہتی ہیں، جن میں دائمی درد، پیشاب یا پاخانے پر کنٹرول نہ ہونا، اور خطرناک سکار ٹشو شامل ہیں۔

ایک خاتون نے اپنے ذاتی تجربے کا ذکر کرتے ہوئے بتایا کہ سیزیرین آپریشن کے سات سال بعد اسے شدید درد اور آنتوں میں رکاوٹ کا سامنا کرنا پڑا جس کی وجہ سے ہنگامی سرجری کرانا پڑی۔ سیزیرین کے دوران بننے والے اندرونی ٹشوز یا ایڈھیژن نے اس کی آنتوں میں خون کی روانی کو محدود کر دیا تھا، جس کے نتیجے میں آنت کا ایک بڑا حصہ نکالنا پڑا۔ اس طرح کے مسائل اکثر سالوں بعد ظاہر ہوتے ہیں اور خواتین کو شدید تکلیف میں مبتلا کرتے ہیں۔

اگرچہ سال 2000 سے 2023 کے دوران زچگی کے دوران ماؤں کی اموات کی شرح میں عالمی سطح پر چالیس فیصد کمی واقع ہوئی ہے، لیکن محققین کا کہنا ہے کہ اس تمام توجہ کا مرکز ماؤں کی جان بچانا رہا ہے جبکہ پیدائش کے بعد کے طویل مدتی اثرات کو نظر انداز کیا گیا ہے۔ آسٹریلیا کے برنیٹ انسٹی ٹیوٹ کے ماہر جوشوا ووگل کے مطابق یہ بات حیران کن اور تشویشناک ہے کہ اتنی بڑی تعداد میں خواتین ان پیچیدگیوں کے خلاف آواز نہیں اٹھا پاتیں۔

دنیا بھر میں سیزیرین کے ذریعے ولادت کا رجحان مسلسل بڑھ رہا ہے اور اب تقریباً اکیس فیصد پیدائشیں اسی طریقے سے ہوتی ہیں۔ ماہرین اور متاثرہ خواتین کا ماننا ہے کہ اس حوالے سے شعور بیدار کرنے کی اشد ضرورت ہے تاکہ خواتین اپنے طبی مسائل پر کھل کر بات کر سکیں اور انہیں بروقت مناسب علاج تک رسائی حاصل ہو سکے۔

stories.title: Pakistan Reaches 151-5 Against Sri Lanka in Weather-Affected Test Match
stories.summary:
The ongoing century drought for Babar Azam continued as Sri Lanka sought a victory during the weather-impacted first Test match held in Rawalpindi on Friday. The visiting team claimed four quick wickets during the morning session while visibility was poor, leaving Pakistan at 151-5 by lunchtime on the fifth and final day, ahead by 139 runs with five wickets left.

At the interval, Saud Shakeel stayed not out on 23 alongside Ghazi Ghori on seven, following a brief twenty-minute interruption caused by bad light that temporarily paused Sri Lanka's pursuit of a 1-0 advantage in the two-match series. Azam fell victim to a leg-side trap, giving a simple catch to the short square-leg fielder off fast bowler Milan Rathnayaka after scoring 34 runs, which extended his streak to 42 innings without a Test hundred.

Shortly after, Salman Agha was dismissed via the same method off Rathnayaka for 13, leaving the batting side in deep trouble at 125-5. Earlier action saw Sri Lanka strike immediately on the day's first ball when Lahiru Kumara dismissed Azan Awais for 22, keeping the overnight total at 57. In the next over, Asitha Fernando sent Mohammad Taha back for 24, making the score 57-3.

Sri Lanka had an earlier opportunity to remove Azam when he was on 22, but Kamindu Mendis dropped a straightforward chance off Fernando's bowling. Azam managed six fours and built a fifty-run fourth-wicket stand with Shakeel before succumbing to a loose shot.

stories.title: وفاقی آئینی عدالت کا ایک سال مکمل، یادگاری ڈاک ٹکٹ جاری
stories.summary:
وفاقی آئینی عدالت کے قیام کا ایک سال مکمل ہونے پر اسلام آباد میں ایک پروقار تقریب کا اہتمام کیا گیا۔ تقریب میں عدالت کے تمام ججز، اٹارنی جنرل اور پاکستان بار و سپریم کورٹ بار کے عہدیداران نے شرکت کی۔ تقریب کے آغاز میں عدالت کے ایک سالہ کارکردگی پر مبنی ایک خصوصی ڈاکومنٹری بھی دکھائی گئی۔

تقریب سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے وفاقی آئینی عدالت کے چیف جسٹس امین الدین خان نے بتایا کہ عدالت نے اس ایک سال کے دوران نو ہزار کیسز کے فیصلے کیے۔ انہوں نے انکشاف کیا کہ اس دوران عدالت نے اسلام آباد ہائی کورٹ کا فیصلہ، وفاقی محتسب اور صدرِ پاکستان کے احکامات کو بھی کالعدم قرار دیا۔ چیف جسٹس نے اس موقع پر یادگاری ڈاک ٹکٹ کی رونمائی کی اور وکلاء کے دلائل کے لیے مقررہ وقت کے اصول کو سراہا۔

چیف جسٹس امین الدین خان نے اپنے خطاب میں اس بات پر زور دیا کہ ججز اور وکلاء کا اصل مقصد سائل کو بروقت انصاف فراہم کرنا ہے اور انسان کو اپنے کام سے کبھی مطمئن نہیں ہو کر ہمیشہ بہتری کی کوشش کرنی چاہیے۔ سالگرہ کی اس تقریب میں ای کورٹ کا باضابطہ افتتاح بھی کیا گیا اور عدالت کے اہم فیصلوں کے اردو ترجمے پر مشتمل ایک کتاب بھی جاری کی گئی۔

تقریب کے اختتام پر چیف جسٹس نے تمام ججز اور وکلاء کو اس کامیابی پر مبارکباد پیش کی اور دل سے کام جاری رکھنے کی ہدایت کی۔ اس ادارے نے اپنے قیام کے پہلے ہی سال میں قانون اور آئین کی تشریح کے حوالے سے اہم سنگ میل عبور کیے ہیں۔

stories.title: رحیم یار خان میں پولیس کا مبینہ مقابلہ، بین الصوبائی گینگ کے دو ڈاکو ہلاک
stories.summary:
رحیم یار خان کے علاقے خانپور کے موضع کامل لاڑ میں پولیس اور جرائم پیشہ ملزمان کے درمیان مبینہ طور پر شدید فائرنگ کا تبادلہ ہوا، جس کے نتیجے میں بین الصوبائی گینگ کے دو خطرناک ڈاکو ہلاک ہو گئے۔ پولیس حکام کے مطابق یہ کارروائی کچے کے علاقے میں عمل میں لائی گئی۔

رحیم یار خان پولیس کی اس جوابی کارروائی کے دوران نامور ڈاکو شاہ میر عرف میرا کوش مارا گیا، جسے پولیس کو طویل عرصے سے تلاش تھا۔ پولیس کا یہ بھی کہنا ہے کہ فائرنگ کے اس تبادلے کے دوران موقع سے چار دیگر ملزمان فائدہ اٹھاتے ہوئے فرار ہونے میں کامیاب ہو گئے۔

ابتدائی تحقیقات اور پولیس ریکارڈ کے مطابق ہلاک ہونے والے یہ ملزمان ایک بین الصوبائی گینگ کے فعال کارندے تھے اور ڈکیتی نیز لوٹ مار کی ایک درجن سے زائد سنگین وارداتوں کے مقدمات میں پولیس کو مطلوب تھے۔

واقعے کے بعد پولیس حکام نے فرار ہو جانے والے باقی ماندہ ملزمان کی فوری گرفتاری کے لیے مختلف سمتوں میں خصوصی کارروائیاں شروع کر دی ہیں تاکہ قانون کے کٹہرے میں لایا جا سکے۔

stories.title: Manchester United Appoints Mauricio Pochettino as New Manager
stories.summary:
Manchester United has officially named Mauricio Pochettino as their new manager following the dismissal of Michael Carrick. The club announced that the former Chelsea, Tottenham, and Southampton boss will formally take over his duties on November 18, once he concludes his commitments with the United States national team over their upcoming matches against Haiti.

The English giants secured an agreement with the US soccer federation allowing Pochettino and his coaching staff to depart after finishing their duties with the men's national team. United highlighted the Argentine manager's reputation for implementing an attacking, high-intensity style of play, fostering strong team cohesion, and successfully developing individual athletes throughout his career across various top-flight leagues.

Pochettino steps into the role at a challenging time, as the twenty-time English champions are currently enduring their worst-ever start to a Premier League campaign. Having secured victory in only one of their initial ten league fixtures, the club finds itself sitting precariously within the relegation zone, placing immense pressure on the incoming coaching staff.

Reflecting on his departure, Pochettino expressed gratitude toward the players, fans, and the federation for supporting his efforts to influence soccer culture in the United States, where he led the team to the last-16 of the World Cup earlier in the year. US Soccer CEO and secretary general JT Batson commended his professionalism and leadership, while Manchester United prepares for his managerial debut against arch-rivals Liverpool on November 22.

stories.title: پنجاب ہولی قرآن پرنٹنگ اینڈ ریکارڈنگ ترمیمی بل 2026 منظور
stories.summary:
پنجاب اسمبلی کی قائمہ کمیٹی برائے اوقاف نے قرآن پاک کی طباعت، اشاعت اور ریکارڈنگ کو غلطیوں سے پاک بنانے کے مقصد سے پنجاب ہولی قرآن پرنٹنگ اینڈ ریکارڈنگ ترمیمی بل 2026 کی متفقہ منظوری دے دی ہے۔ یہ اجلاس فاروق خان مانیکا کی صدارت میں منعقد ہوا، جس میں رانا محمد ارشد اور دیگر عہدیداران نے شرکت کی۔ بل کا بنیادی مقصد قرآن پاک کی بے حرمتی، تحریف، تبدیلی یا توہین کو روکنے کے لیے ایک جامع قانونی لائحہ عمل مرتب کرنا ہے۔

بل کے متن کے مطابق، اگر کسی بھی مقام پر کوئی قابل اعتراض تحریر، نشان، تصویر یا مواد پایا جاتا ہے تو تفتیشی پولیس افسر کو فوری طور پر اسے قبضے میں لینے کا اختیار حاصل ہوگا۔ اس مواد کو متعلقہ مجسٹریٹ کے سامنے پیش کرنا لازمی ہوگا، جس کی ہدایت پر پنجاب فرانزک سائنس اتھارٹی یا نامزد لیبارٹری کے ذریعے شواہد محفوظ کیے جائیں گے۔ اس کے بعد اصل مواد پنجاب قرآن بورڈ کے حوالے کیا جائے گا، جو اس کی محفوظ تحویل، بحالی، صفائی یا باادب تلفی کا فیصلہ کرے گا۔

قانون میں یہ تجویز بھی شامل کی گئی ہے کہ اگر کسی شخص یا جاندار کے جسم پر کوئی قابل اعتراض تحریر، نشان، ٹیٹو یا پینٹنگ موجود ہو تو اسے ہٹانے سے قبل تصاویر اور ویڈیوز کے ذریعے شواہد محفوظ کیے جائیں گے۔ متعلقہ فرد کو اپنا مؤقف پیش کرنے کا موقع دینے کے بعد مجسٹریٹ کے حکم پر یہ مواد ہٹایا جائے گا۔ اس کے علاوہ بوسیدہ یا مسخ شدہ نسخوں کے شواہد محفوظ کر کے انہیں باادب طریقے سے تلف کرنے کا طریقہ کار بھی وضع کیا گیا ہے۔

سوشل میڈیا اور ڈیجیٹل پلیٹ فارمز پر قرآن پاک اور مقدس شخصیات کے خلاف توہین آمیز مواد سے پھیلنے والی مذہبی بے چینی کو روکنے کے لیے بھی اقدامات تجویز کیے گئے ہیں۔ اس سلسلے میں پی ٹی اے یا متعلقہ اداروں کو غیر قانونی مواد ہٹانے، بلاک کرنے یا رسائی بند کرنے کے اختیارات دینے کی منظوری دی گئی ہے۔ مزید برآں، قرآن بورڈ کے خصوصی سیل میں وزیراعلیٰ کی صوابدید پر غیر سرکاری ارکان کے ساتھ سرکاری ارکان کی تقرری کی بھی منظوری دی گئی ہے۔

کمیٹی سے منظوری کے بعد اس بل کو حتمی منظوری کے لیے ایوان میں پیش کیا جائے گا، جہاں سے منظوری کے بعد گورنر پنجاب اس پر دستخط کریں گے۔ اس قانون سازی کا مقصد قرآن پاک کے تقدس کو پامال ہونے سے بچانا اور غلطیوں یا توہین کے مرتکب عناصر کے خلاف فرانزک شواہد کی بنیاد پر شفاف قانونی کارروائی کا مؤثر نظام قائم کرنا ہے۔

stories.title: Microsoft Denies Malicious Activity Behind Global Outlook and Teams Outage
stories.summary:
Microsoft stated that it found no indication of malicious intent behind a major 10-hour service disruption that impacted Outlook and Teams globally on Friday. The tech company struggled with server issues that affected government bodies and commercial users worldwide, with Downdetector recording over 25,000 incident reports in the United States at 9:30 p.m. ET and a peak of more than 130,000 reports around 1 p.m. ET on Thursday. 

Features relying on Exchange Online and email faced heavy disruptions, while parts of Microsoft 365 independent of the cloud messaging platform remained operational. Australian Home Affairs and Cyber Security Minister Tony Burke noted that Microsoft compared the incident to the 2024 CrowdStrike software malfunction, believing a faulty update caused the server unavailability rather than a cyberattack. 

Authorities across multiple regions, including the Australian federal police and spy agency as well as the US House of Representatives, were impacted by the technical glitch. Microsoft explained that it was routing traffic through alternative paths and attempting to bring affected servers back online while observing a limited recovery. 

Other tech entities also reported secondary impacts from the disruption. OpenAI noted issues with broken Microsoft connectors, Anthropic identified an upstream provider complication affecting its Microsoft 365 connector, and commercial entities like Workhorse Group postponed financial disclosures due to the worldwide digital disruption.

stories.title: Deputy Prime Minister Dar Stresses Strict Implementation of Government Austerity Measures
stories.summary:
Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar called on state institutions to maintain close coordination to ensure the effective implementation of government austerity protocols. Presiding over a meeting of the Committee for Monitoring and Implementation of Conservation and Additional Austerity Measures at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Dar emphasized the necessity of achieving sustainable savings through rigorous resource conservation and expenditure management.
