International reactions to the ongoing conflict continued as Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan urged both the United States and Iran to restart negotiations immediately. Meeting with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian on the sidelines of a UN climate conference in Antalya, Turkey, Erdogan emphasized the necessity of finding common ground to end the hostilities. The current Middle East war commenced on February 28 following US-Israeli strikes that resulted in the assassination of Iran's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, prompting retaliatory missile and drone attacks across the region from Tehran.

stories.title: Putin Rejects Ukraine Compromise During Kremlin Talks with US Envoys
stories.summary:
Russian President Vladimir Putin stated on Thursday that Moscow will not soften its hardline demands to end the conflict in Ukraine, despite offering a short-term ceasefire in a vital frontline city. During a televised Kremlin meeting with visiting US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, Putin dismissed the possibility of establishing demilitarized zones or accepting foreign peacekeeping troops, asserting that such deployments would merely prolong the war. The discussions followed two days of preliminary talks in Abu Dhabi aimed at resolving Europe's most severe military conflict since World War II.

While maintaining rigid territorial demands regarding parts of Ukraine claimed as annexed by Russia, Putin agreed to permit European representatives to participate in the next round of peace negotiations. US envoy Witkoff confirmed the inclusion of European partners after meeting with the Russian leader, though Putin maintained that Washington must coordinate with European allies to clarify their intentions regarding peace or continued hostilities. Moscow has consistently sought to position these talks within the broader framework of European security architecture.

Following their departure from the Kremlin, Kushner and Witkoff traveled directly to Dublin to confer with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, who was attending a European summit. In the Irish capital, Zelensky highlighted ongoing challenges, including recent operational restrictions placed on the Starshield satellite internet service that negatively impact Ukrainian frontline communications and drone interception capabilities. Russian forces continue to occupy substantial portions of eastern and southern Ukraine in addition to Crimea, which was annexed in 2014.

stories.title: Peshawar Police Enforce Total Ban on Private Dispute Resolution Jirgas
stories.summary:
Peshawar police have enacted a formal ban on private jirgas, which are informal dispute-resolution gatherings, and issued strict warnings to local wedding halls, hotels, and restaurants against hosting such events on their properties.

Capital City Police Officer (CCPO) Dr Mian Saeed Ahmad confirmed the directive, stating that violations of the order will result in immediate legal action against both organizers and venue providers. The decision follows multiple complaints and incidents that highlighted severe issues tied to these unregulated meetings.

Authorities stated that private jirgas frequently promote local gun culture, coerce participants into depositing large surety amounts, and frequently culminate in violent clashes at the venue. Furthermore, private organizers often charge exorbitant fees and demand lavish meals, placing an unnecessary financial strain on the disputing parties.

The ban was implemented because the government has already established Dispute Resolution Committees (DRCs) that operate under police supervision free of charge. Unlike private jirgas, which CCPO Ahmad noted have devolved into commercial enterprises linked to land grabbing, DRCs provide an independent, transparent alternative for community members.

This regulatory enforcement aims to curb illegal coercion, eliminate financial exploitation, and reduce gun violence in the region. Police have also stated they will actively recover illegally charged money and return it to victims while cracking down on individuals who provide space for unauthorized gatherings.

stories.title: Pakistani Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi Floats Referendum on New Administrative Units
stories.summary:
Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi proposed holding a public referendum on Thursday to decide whether to create new administrative provinces, suggesting the vote would definitively conclude a long-standing political debate. Speaking to journalists at the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency in Lahore, Naqvi assured political parties that they would be consulted before any concrete steps are taken. He argued that survey reports indicate smaller administrative units could improve governance, and noted that opponents of the proposal should present viable alternative solutions for the public to consider.

The proposal follows recent political friction surrounding administrative reforms, with Defence Minister Khawaja Asif supporting smaller units based on administrative efficiency, while the Pakistan Peoples Party opposes division within Sindh. Addressing broader political dialogue, Naqvi noted alignment with PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari's calls for a political reset to confront economic challenges. Additionally, Naqvi acknowledged that corruption remains widespread throughout the country and stressed the collective responsibility of the government to address and eliminate it wherever it occurs.

During his media interaction, Naqvi also addressed several other prominent national issues. He defended recent notices issued by the Capital Development Authority regarding the residence of JUI-F chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman, clarifying that the enforcement campaign was routine and not targeted at specific individuals. Furthermore, the interior minister dismissed circulating rumors of a behind-the-scenes political deal involving detained PTI founder Imran Khan, emphasizing that any relief for Khan and his family will be determined strictly through the legal court system.

stories.title: Pakistan Lowers Petrol and High-Speed Diesel Prices Starting November 13
stories.summary:
Fuel consumers in Pakistan are set to experience slight financial relief at pump stations beginning November 13, following an official reduction in petroleum prices. According to announcements made in Islamabad by journalist Wasim Iqbal, the ex-depot retail rate of petrol has been lowered by Rs3 per litre, shifting the cost downward from Rs335 to Rs332. In a similar adjustment, the price of High-Speed Diesel (HSD) has been decreased by Rs4 per litre, moving the price tag from Rs364 to Rs360.

Regulatory authorities attributed these price adjustments to broader global market developments alongside shifts in Platts pricing benchmarks, associated premiums, and incidental costs. Internationally, benchmark prices for petrol declined from USD 93.55 per barrel down to USD 91.64 per barrel. Meanwhile, the premium including freight costs rose to USD 28.76 per barrel. For High-Speed Diesel, international benchmark prices dropped from USD 96.33 to USD 94.16 per barrel.

On an ex-refinery basis, the cost for petrol dropped to Rs237.31 per litre from its previous level of Rs240.65, while the ex-refinery cost for HSD fell to Rs252.08 per litre compared to Rs255.88 previously. These domestic reductions reflect shifting global crude values while local duties and profit margins remain entirely unaffected.

Government levies and fixed profit margins for both petrol and High-Speed Diesel remain completely unchanged. Each fuel type carries a Petroleum Levy of Rs80 per litre, a Climate Support Levy of Rs5 per litre, and fixed profit margins of Rs9.98 per litre for dealers alongside Rs7.87 per litre for oil marketing companies. Furthermore, the Inland Freight Equalisation Margin remains fixed at Rs8.17 per litre for petrol and Rs5.10 per litre for HSD.

stories.title: Finance Minister Aurangzeb Urges International Investment in Pakistani Sovereign Sukuk
stories.summary:
Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb called upon international investors to increase their participation in Pakistan’s sovereign Sukuk, noting that foreign capital inflows into these Shariah-compliant instruments remain underwhelming. Speaking in Islamabad at a ceremony commemorating the achievement of Rs10 trillion in sovereign Sukuk issuance, the minister highlighted that total Sukuk issuance surged by 113 percent year-on-year in 2026 to reach Rs4.4 trillion, up from approximately Rs2 trillion a year prior. He noted that the five-year compound annual growth rate stands at roughly 22 percent compared to nearly Rs761 billion in 2020.

Aurangzeb explained that the government has introduced hybrid and short-term Shariah-compliant instruments with maturities ranging from three to six months to diversify financing sources and establish a comprehensive yield curve. He also pointed out that hybrid government Sukuks combine different Islamic structures to provide greater flexibility in utilizing state-owned assets. Despite positive inflows through Special Convertible Rupee Accounts into conventional instruments like Treasury Bills and Pakistan Investment Bonds, foreign investment in Sukuk has lagged behind expectations, prompting the minister to urge banks, brokers, and market dealers to actively promote them abroad.

To broaden the domestic investor base, the minister advocated for expanding retail participation through digital channels, enabling individual citizens to invest amounts as low as Rs5,000. Addressing corporate debt, Aurangzeb revealed that the Ministry of Power has issued a mandate to the National Debt Company to launch the nation's first-ever listed corporate Sukuk. He emphasized that institutions such as the State Bank of Pakistan, Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan, Pakistan Stock Exchange, and Central Depository Company must coordinate closely to build a robust Islamic capital market ecosystem.

Concluding his address, Aurangzeb underscored the importance of applying Ijtihad and informed reasoning rooted in the Quran and Sunnah to navigate modern financial challenges. He encouraged religious scholars and economic experts to focus on common ground rather than differences. Such cooperative efforts, he stated, are essential for strengthening Pakistan's Islamic finance landscape and ensuring sustainable economic progress.

stories.title: Iran Reports Four Oil Tankers Struck by Explosions in Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary:
Four oil tankers were struck by explosions in the Strait of Hormuz after entering restricted areas and ignoring official warnings, according to statements released by Iran’s military on Thursday. The incidents occurred despite a recent rebound in maritime traffic and falling oil prices driven by expectations of a de-escalation in the ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran. Iran’s Revolutionary Guards Navy stated that two supertankers were disabled on Wednesday after hitting naval mines along what authorities designated an unauthorized route, state media broadcasting video footage of the blasts.

Iranian state television reported that two additional tankers struck mines on Thursday afternoon while navigating the eastern portion of the Strait of Hormuz. According to official reports, these vessels had similarly ignored prior warnings and disabled their radar systems before entering the restricted zone and catching fire. These events follow a shift in how the IRGC Navy reports maritime incidents, moving from explicitly claiming direct attacks earlier in the US-Israeli conflict to attributing recent vessel fires to floating naval mines.

Independent maritime monitoring agencies have documented similar incidents with varying accounts of the causes. The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency reported that a vessel was struck by an unknown projectile roughly 14 nautical miles northwest of Ras Al-Khaimah while exiting the strait on Wednesday. That strike ignited a fire in the ship's engine room, prompting a full evacuation of the crew and ongoing firefighting operations.

Shipping traffic through the strategic waterway has faced continuous security threats since the conflict began in late February. Data compiled by the Washington Institute for Near East Policy indicates that at least 10 ships were struck during the first ten days of November alone. This followed a high tally of 37 attacks recorded in October, marking the worst monthly total since hostilities originally commenced.

stories.title: Pakistan Inaugurates PMIF-2026 to Showcase Mineral Wealth and Attract Investment
stories.summary:
Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar inaugurated the third Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum (PMIF-2026) in Islamabad on Thursday, calling for international investment, technology transfer, and industrial cooperation. With representatives from over 60 countries in attendance, Dar emphasized that Pakistan aims to transition from exporting raw minerals to establishing domestic processing, refining, and manufacturing capabilities. He noted that mineral development is critical for diversifying exports, strengthening the industrial base, and creating employment.

Highlighting the nation's geological wealth, Dar pointed to significant copper and gold reserves along the Tethyan Metallogenic Belt in western Pakistan, alongside deposits of iron ore, chromite, lead, zinc, coal, rock salt, marble, gypsum, and gemstones. He cited the RekoDiq copper-gold project in Balochistan as a prime model of collaboration involving Barrick Gold, federal state-owned enterprises, and the provincial government. Dar stressed that the government seeks to develop complete value chains supported by the National Mineral Policy, the Pakistan Investment Policy 2023, and the Special Investment Facilitation Council, while cultivating strong economic ties with China, Saudi Arabia, Gulf nations, Turkey, and Central Asian partners.

Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb, speaking at the forum, outlined Pakistan's broader macroeconomic progress aimed at achieving sustainable, export-led growth. He reported that the country reduced its twin deficit from roughly 12.5 percent of Gross Domestic Product to 2.6 percent by June 2026, achieved a 22-year low fiscal deficit, and recorded primary surpluses for three consecutive years. Furthermore, foreign exchange reserves reached a historic high of USD 21.5 billion, which covers over three months of imports. Aurangzeb noted that these buffers helped the nation withstand economic shocks such as the October 2025 floods and regional Gulf conflicts.

To solidify these economic gains, Aurangzeb emphasized that Pakistan is pursuing deep structural reforms across taxation, energy, public finance, and tariffs, while actively privatizing state-owned enterprises. The government projects a four percent economic growth rate for the current fiscal year, following nearly 3.7 percent growth the previous year. By keeping export financing rates between 4.5 and 6 percent and lowering taxes for exporters, the administration hopes to avoid import-driven balance-of-payments pressures and establish long-term economic stability.

stories.title: Government Directs SBP to Prepare Working Paper for Raast QR MDR Scheme
stories.summary:
The Pakistani government has instructed the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) to create a working paper for the approval of the Raast QR Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) scheme. This move aims to maintain the growth of digital payments following a fourfold rise in active merchants, reaching 2.03 million under the Prime Minister's Cashless Pakistan initiative. Minister of State for Railways and Finance Bilal Azhar Kayani led a high-level follow-up meeting at the Finance Division to review progress and refine the framework.

Several key advancements were highlighted during the meeting, including the transition of all Asaan Assignment Account payments to the Raast system starting November 16, with trained Drawing and Disbursing Officers. Additionally, Raast QR codes have been placed on over 45 million gas and electricity bills, and all National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) centers have been equipped for digital transactions. Overall digital payment volumes have doubled in a single year.

To ensure continued expansion, the Minister of State will meet with bank presidents and CEOs in Karachi to discuss stakeholder collaboration. Furthermore, the SBP has been tasked with assessing macroeconomic indicators, such as the ratio of RTGS-processed payments to GDP, to measure broader economic outcomes effectively.

The meeting drew numerous high-level participants from both the public and private sectors. Attendees included senior officials from the Finance Division, SBP, Ministry of Information Technology and Telecommunication, and NADRA, alongside leaders from Easypaisa Digital Bank, JazzCash, Bank Alfalah, JS Bank, and Karandaaz Pakistan. Authorities stressed the necessity of strengthening coordination to meet national digital goals.

stories.title: Federal Minister for Petroleum Meets Global Mining Executives at PMIF
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Petroleum Ali Pervaiz Malik engaged in bilateral discussions with international mining and investment leaders during the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum (PMIF). The meetings emphasized Pakistan's dedication to securing foreign investment and forging global partnerships within the mineral sector. The minister met separately with Barrick Mining Corporation Chairman John Thornton, Weir CEO Andrew Neilson, Trafigura MENA Head of Metals and Minerals Ibrahim El Gazzar, and Çalik Holding CEO Mustafa Aksoy, alongside a delegation led by Ivanhoe Mines' Robert Friedland.

During the talks, Andrew Neilson stated that Weir wants to expand its footprint in Pakistan's mining sector beyond its current involvement at Reko Diq. Ibrahim El Gazzar mentioned Trafigura's strong interest in the nation's Zinc-Barite project, as well as potential ventures in LPG, bonded storage, and refinery sectors. John Thornton noted his appreciation for visiting the country, highlighting Barrick Mining Corporation's ongoing engagement.

A major highlight of the forum was a signing ceremony witnessed by the petroleum minister between Ivanhoe Mines and Mari Minerals. The agreement establishes a partnership to explore copper and gold deposits in Chagai, Balochistan, allowing both entities to evaluate the area's mineral potential and develop its resources.

Minister Malik praised the rising international interest in Pakistan's mineral resources. He underscored that the PMIF serves as a vital bridge connecting global investors with lucrative opportunities, facilitating cooperative ventures, and unlocking the country's extensive mineral wealth.

stories.title: State Bank of Pakistan Raises Currency Transaction Report Threshold to Rs3 Million
stories.summary:
Acting on federal government instructions, the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) raised the minimum threshold for reporting Currency Transaction Reports (CTR) to its Financial Monitoring Unit (FMU). Effective immediately, the new limit is set at Rs3 million under the Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010. This replaces the previous Rs2 million threshold established in January 2015.

The SBP formally communicated the revision to banks and regulated entities via a circular letter. The change follows a notification issued by the Minister of Finance and originates from a decision by the National Executive Committee on Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT). The committee utilized powers granted under Section 2(xi) of the Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010, to modify the older Finance Division notification from 2015.

Regulated entities are mandated to ensure full compliance with the updated threshold requirements. Furthermore, financial institutions must maintain comprehensive records of both domestic and international transactions, including inquiry results regarding complex or unusual large transactions, for a minimum duration of ten years.

Institutions are also required to retain all records concerning filed Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and CTRs for the same ten-year period starting from the completion date of the transaction, ensuring regulatory accountability and transparency across the financial sector.

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Advocates for Grant-Based Climate Finance at COP31
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif urged global leaders to adopt grant-based climate financing and expand adaptation funds during his national statement at the Antalya Leaders Summit of COP31. He emphasized that vulnerable developing nations require immediate financial assistance through mechanisms like public-private partnerships that do not exacerbate their existing debt burdens. Resilience and adaptation funds, he noted, are essential survival tools for struggling economies facing escalating climate disasters.

Recalling Pakistan's severe climate challenges, the prime minister referenced the 2022 floods that submerged one-third of the country, affected 33 million individuals, killed over 1,700 people, and caused more than $30 billion in economic damages. He also shared the tragic story of a young man affected by the August 2025 flash floods in Buner to illustrate the heavy human toll borne by populations least responsible for global emissions. He reiterated that climate change respects no borders and demands unified action.

Highlighting domestic clean energy milestones, the prime minister stated that Pakistan added over 20 gigawatts of distributed solar capacity in two years, with clean sources now comprising nearly 55 percent of its energy mix. He also mentioned progress in nuclear energy, including the recent dome placement for the 1,200-megawatt Chashma-5 Nuclear Power Plant, alongside goals to cut projected emissions by up to 50 percent by 2035 through electric mobility and other measures.

Concluding his address, the prime minister stressed water security, asserting that water must never be weaponized against downstream populations and that water-sharing agreements must be strictly honored. He thanked Türkiye for hosting COP31 and for its historical support during major floods, while urging the international community to judge the success of the summit by tangible actions and protected lives.

stories.title: Distributed Solar Adoption Drives Down Gas Output in Pakistan
stories.summary:
According to the Renewables First Pakistan Energy Market Review, Pakistan's indigenous natural gas production declined by 8 percent in the 2025 fiscal year. Concurrently, the consumption of imported Regasified Liquefied Natural Gas in the power sector dropped by 24 percent. This shift was largely driven by the expansion of distributed solar generation, which displaced expensive fuel-based electricity and reduced dependence on imported fossil fuels.

The report notes that local gas production fell due to the depletion of mature fields and limited exploration activity. Excess LNG availability also led to the curtailment of domestic gas production. LNG imports decreased by 4 percent to 8.7 million tonnes of oil equivalent. Meanwhile, higher industrial activity pushed RLNG consumption in other sectors up by 54 percent, and industrial gas consumption grew by 3.6 percent, driven mainly by export industries and cement production.

Distributed solar has helped Pakistan avoid approximately $15 billion in fossil fuel imports by the 2026 fiscal year, easing pressure on foreign exchange reserves. The analysis estimates that solar panels and inverters imported for $8.9 billion have helped avoid nearly $14.7 billion in fuel imports. Further investments could bring cumulative savings to about $124 billion between FY17 and FY50, saving roughly nine dollars in fossil fuel imports for every dollar invested.

Other energy sectors also experienced shifts during FY25. Oil supplies increased by 15 percent, while domestic crude production fell by 12 percent, forcing refineries to import 77 percent of their crude requirements. Petroleum consumption in the power sector plummeted by 77 percent. Indigenous coal production saw its first reduction since FY15, falling by 3 percent, while coal imports rose to 4.6 million tonnes of oil equivalent to meet industrial demand.

stories.title: Sui Gas Utilities Petition Regulator for Price Hikes in FY27
stories.summary:
State-owned utilities Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited and Sui Southern Gas Company Limited have submitted petitions to the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority. They are seeking increases in their average prescribed gas prices for the fiscal year 2026-27, with the changes requested to take effect retrospectively from July 1.

Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited has requested an increase of Rs10 per million British thermal units, which would raise its average prescribed price from Rs1,702 to Rs1,712.40. This request includes Rs60.147 billion in liquefied natural gas service costs, placing the cost of LNG for the company at Rs471.16 per MMBtu.

Sui Southern Gas Company Limited has asked for a much larger increase of Rs366.75 per MMBtu, aiming to push its average prescribed price to Rs2,071.75. Both gas utilities pointed to higher international crude oil prices as a contributing factor for needing price adjustments.

Additionally, Sui Northern noted that limited availability of indigenous gas during the winter season will require additional arrangements, estimating that 16 LNG cargoes will be needed to meet demand. The regulatory authority will hold public hearings on these applications before making a final decision regarding the requested price adjustments.

stories.title: Islamabad High Court Seeks Ministries' Replies on PLI Funds
stories.summary:
The Islamabad High Court directed the Ministries of Finance and Communications to submit responses regarding a petition concerning Rs 48 billion in Postal Life Insurance policyholders' funds. Justice Arbab Muhammad Tahir heard the public interest constitutional petition filed by the Judicial Activism Panel during a Thursday session.

The petitioner's counsel raised concerns about the fate of the Rs 48 billion belonging to government servants, retired employees, pensioners, widows, and other citizens who invested savings in Postal Life Insurance policies. Matured insurance claims have reportedly been delayed or left unpaid due to the stated non-availability of funds. Officials from Pakistan Post and the federal communications minister have acknowledged that the money remains with the Finance Division.

The legal challenge references the Auditor-General of Pakistan's Special Study Report for 2022-23, which uncovered financial and administrative irregularities during the conversion of Postal Life Insurance into Postal Life Insurance Company Limited. The report stated that out of Rs 8 billion released by the Finance Division in 2021-22, Rs 3.1 billion went toward claims while Rs 4.9 billion was surrendered, alongside unsettled claims totaling approximately Rs 7.99 billion and un-transferred premiums.

The petition argues that individual insurance premiums cannot automatically be treated as federal government revenue under Article 78(1) of the Constitution and should fall under the Public Account. It invokes multiple constitutional articles and the Insurance Ordinance of 2000, asking for an independent forensic audit, disclosure of financial records, and the timely settlement of matured claims to protect the rights of ordinary citizens.

stories.title: Mercedes-Benz Halts German Investments Amid Growing Cost Pressures
stories.summary:
German automaker Mercedes-Benz announced that it will halt all investments in Germany and consider plant closures. The decision highlights ongoing challenges within the country's automotive sector, which has been impacted by intense Chinese competition and high operational costs. Last month, Mercedes became the third major German car manufacturer to lower its financial outlook for the year.

Company management has been engaged in discussions with staff representatives to negotiate cost reductions. However, with little progress made during these talks, leadership decided to adopt a stricter approach. Michael Schiebe, a member of the executive board, stated in an internal intranet interview that the board jointly agreed to freeze all future investments at German sites.

Schiebe noted that despite numerous intensive discussions, management could not find a viable path forward with labor unions. As a result, the manufacturer stated it is compelled to carefully evaluate which German sites may face closure if cost structures cannot be successfully altered.

stories.title: Australia Captain Pat Cummins Strongly Denies 2018 Sandpaper Plot Claims
stories.summary:
Australian Test captain Pat Cummins has firmly rejected allegations made in Usman Khawaja's new autobiography that all players knew about the ball-tampering plot during a 2018 Test against South Africa. Speaking in Sydney on Friday, Cummins labeled assertions that he and others were architects of the sandpaper scheme as utter nonsense and completely untrue.

The scandal dates back to 2018 when then-captain Steve Smith, vice-captain David Warner, and opening batsman Cameron Bancroft received significant suspensions from Cricket Australia for bringing the sport into disrepute. Cummins expressed surprise at Khawaja's admission regarding telling Bancroft to be cautious, emphasizing that such actions do not align with the team culture rebuilt over the past eight years.

While acknowledging Khawaja's right to share his story, Cummins criticized his teammate and friend for being casual with the lives and reputations of others. The skipper stated he had no recollection of discussions regarding collective responsibility for the incident and was unaware which two players supposedly rejected such a call.

Despite receiving legal advice that certain statements in the book were likely defamatory, Cummins confirmed he will not pursue legal action against Khawaja. He stressed the importance of moving past the events of eight years ago and drawing a line under the controversy.

stories.title: England Reach Nations League Quarter-Finals While Italy Defeats France
stories.summary:
England secured their progression to the UEFA Nations League quarter-finals following a 2-1 victory over Croatia at Wembley Stadium on Thursday. Harry Kane marked his record-breaking 126th appearance for the national team by converting a crucial penalty after a VAR review, bringing his international goal tally to 92. Morgan Rogers had initially opened the scoring for England in the first half before Petar Sucic equalized for Croatia following an error by Jarell Quansah.

Thomas Tuchel's side advanced to 12 points in Group A3, setting up a decisive group-stage finale against Spain in Madrid. Spain maintained their top position with 15 points after defeating the Czech Republic 2-0 in Prague, courtesy of an Alex Baena penalty and a late strike from Marc Pubill. The Czech side finished the match with ten men following the red card issued to captain Ladislav Krejci.

In Group A1, Italy handed Zinedine Zidane his first defeat as France coach by coming from behind to secure a 3-1 victory in Milan. Despite France taking an early lead through Michael Olise after a defensive error by Gianluigi Donnarumma, Italy responded with goals from Francesco Pio Esposito and Davide Frattesi. Esposito later added a second penalty to seal the win.

With this result, Italy moved ahead of France at the top of Group A1 on head-to-head records, as both teams sit on ten points ahead of their final fixtures. Meanwhile, Belgium kept their qualification hopes alive by defeating Turkiye 2-1 in Izmir, overcoming an opening goal from Arda Guler with strikes by Kevin De Bruyne and Charles De Ketelaere.

stories.title: بھکر میں نو سالہ بچی کو ہراساں کرنے والے ملزم مجاہد کو گرفتار کر لیا گیا
stories.summary:
صوبہ پنجاب کے شہر بھکر کے نواحی علاقے دریا خان میں نو سالہ کمسن بچی کے ساتھ نازیبا حرکات کرنے والے ملزم کو پولیس نے گرفتار کر کے اس کے خلاف باقاعدہ مقدمہ درج کر لیا ہے۔ پولیس کے مطابق حراست میں لیے جانے والے ملزم کی شناخت مجاہد کے نام سے ہوئی ہے جو محلہ سنہری مسجد کا رہائشی ہے۔ واقعے کی اطلاع ملنے پر مقامی پولیس نے فوری کارروائی کرتے ہوئے ملزم کو دبوچ لیا۔

ڈی پی او بھکر شاہد احمد چدھڑ نے اس واقعے پر سخت ردعمل دیتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ بچوں اور خواتین کے خلاف ہونے والے تشدد، ہراسگی اور جنسی نوعیت کے جرائم کے خلاف پولیس کی پالیسی 'زیرو ٹالرنس' پر مبنی ہے۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ کمسن بچوں اور خواتین کا تحفظ پولیس کی اولین ترجیح ہے اور اس قبیح فعل میں ملوث عناصر کے ساتھ سختی سے نمٹا جائے گا۔ قانون ششکنی کرنے والوں کو کیفر کردار تک پہنچایا جائے گا تاکہ ایسے واقعات کی روک تھام کی جا سکے۔

stories.title: رانا ثنا اللہ کا کہنا ہے کہ اداروں سے دوری ناممکن ہے
stories.summary:
وزیراعظم کے مشیر برائے سیاسی امور رانا ثنا اللہ نے ایک ٹی وی پروگرام میں گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ یہ سازشی نظریہ غلط ہے کہ بانی پی ٹی آئی سے ملاقات 28 ویں ترمیم کے لیے کروائی گئی۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ اداروں سے دوری نہ کبھی ہوئی ہے اور نہ ہو سکے گی، اور ہمارے اعتماد کی بنیادی وجہ وزیراعظم اور فیلڈ مارشل کی شخصیات ہیں۔ اس موقع پر دیگر سیاسی رہنماؤں کے بیانات بھی سامنے آئے جن میں پی ٹی آئی کے رہنما علی محمد خان نے بیرسٹر گوہر اور محسن نقوی کے درمیان رابطوں کی تصدیق کی، جبکہ تحریک انصاف کے سیکریٹری جنرل سلمان اکرم راجہ نے لطیف کھوسہ کے بیانات کو حقائق کے برعکس قرار دیا۔

متعدد دیگر اہم واقعات میں، دریائے یاسین سے ریسکیو حکام نے 11 افراد کی لاشیں نکالی ہیں جن میں دو کمسن بچے بھی شامل ہیں، اور اندھیرے کی وجہ سے آپریشن میں مشکلات پیش آئیں۔ پشاور میں کورائی پولیس اسٹیشن کے گیٹ پر نامعلوم دہشت گردوں نے بارودی پک اپ گاڑی ٹکرائی اور فائرنگ کی جس کے نتیجے میں دو شہری، کلیم اللہ اور بی بی لائبہ، شہید جبکہ تین ایف سی اہلکاروں سمیت کئی افراد زخمی ہو گئے۔ اس کے علاوہ، احتساب عدالت پشاور میں اپر کوہستان اسکینڈل کے ملزم کیشئر مشرف شاہ نے پلی بارگین کی درخواست دائر کر دی ہے، جس کا تحریری فیصلہ جج نے جاری کر دیا ہے۔

کراچی میں ان لینڈ ریونیو کے گریڈ 17 اور اس سے اوپر کے افسران کی صلاحیتیں جانچنے کے لیے انکم ٹیکس اور سیلز ٹیکس کے ٹیسٹ لیے گئے۔ نارتھ ناظم آباد میں میر رضا کے دوست اور پارٹنر کی ایک فوڈ چین برانچ کو سیل کر کے ریکارڈ ضبط کر لیا گیا۔ مزید برآں، سیکیورٹی ذرائع نے کلگام کے واقعے پر بھارتی میڈیا کے پروپیگنڈے کو مسترد کرتے ہوئے اسے فالس فلیگ کارروائی قرار دیا جو کسی سنجیدہ ردعمل کے قابل نہیں۔ ریلوے حکام کی جانب سے اعلان کیا گیا ہے کہ پشاور کے لیے کل نہ تو جعفر ایکسپریس روانہ ہوگی اور نہ ہی جناح پیپلز ٹرین چلے گی۔

stories.title: Mohsin Naqvi Advocates Public Referendum on New Provinces Issue in Pakistan
stories.summary:
Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi stated that seeking public opinion is the most effective approach to resolving the debate surrounding the establishment of new provinces in Pakistan. Speaking to media representatives at the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency in Lahore, Naqvi emphasized that every political party holds a distinct viewpoint on the matter, noting that the Pakistan Peoples Party maintains its own specific stance.

Naqvi stressed that governance decisions should not rely on disagreement, maintaining that consensus among major political allies, including the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz and the PPP, remains essential. The remarks followed recent discussions regarding a potential 28th Constitutional Amendment and a reported proposal to reorganize the country into 12 provinces. Proponents argue the restructuring would enhance administrative decentralization and resource distribution, while critics like PPP leader Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari have opposed the idea in Sindh, calling instead for a political reset.

In addition to provincial discussions, Naqvi addressed agency operations, announcing that the NCCIA complaint cell will integrate into the Pak ID platform. Highlighting resource constraints, he noted that the Punjab branch currently operates with only 61 personnel and requires staffing increases. He reiterated a strict stance against cyber blackmail and corruption within the interior ministry.

Addressing unrelated political queries regarding the PTI founder and his legal standing, Naqvi remarked that rumors offer short-lived media coverage and that individuals will receive whatever outcomes are determined by the courts. Government officials continue to evaluate administrative structures as part of broader governance considerations.

stories.title: کراچی میں پولیس کے مبینہ مقابلے، تین زخمیوں سمیت متعدد ملزمان گرفتار
stories.summary:
کراچی کے مختلف علاقوں میں پولیس کے مبینہ مقابلوں کے دوران تین ملزمان زخمی حالت میں پکڑے گئے جبکہ دو خواتین سمیت دیگر افراد کو بھی حراست میں لے لیا گیا۔ پولیس نے کارروائیوں کے دوران ملزمان کے قبضے سے اسلحہ، گاڑیاں، موٹرسائیکلیں، نقدی اور دیگر سامان برآمد کرنے کا دعویٰ کیا ہے۔

ڈیفنس کے علاقے میں سی آر اے پٹہ کے قریب مبینہ مقابلے کے بعد پولیس نے ایک زخمی ملزم خرم شہزاد عرف عرفان اشرف اور دو خواتین نسرین اختر عرف شہناز اور صغریٰ عرف پروین شوکت کو گرفتار کر لیا۔ اس موقع پر ملزم کا ایک اور ساتھی ارشد علی عرف لنگڑا بھی پکڑا گیا جبکہ دیگر چھ ساتھی فرار ہو گئے۔ گرفتار ملزمان کے ہمراہ ایک تین سالہ بچہ بھی موجود تھا، اور ان کے پاس سے ایک آلٹو کار، دو موٹرسائیکلیں، پستول، نقد رقم اور مصنوعی زیورات برآمد ہوئے۔

گلشن معمار کے علاقے جنجال گوٹھ میں بھی پولیس اور ڈاکوؤں کے درمیان مبینہ مقابلہ ہوا جس میں ایک ڈاکو سلیمان زخمی حالت میں پکڑا گیا۔ اسی طرح تیموریہ پولیس نے نارتھ ناظم آباد کی بلال کالونی میں مقابلے کے بعد پیر بخش عرف لال نامی ملزم کو زخمی حالت میں دبوچ لیا۔

تمام زخمی ملزمان کو طبی امداد کی فراہمی کے لیے جناح اسپتال منتقل کر دیا گیا۔ پولیس کے مطابق گلشن معمار اور تیموریہ کے واقعات میں پکڑے گئے ملزمان کے قبضے سے اسلحہ، موبائل فون، نقدی اور موٹرسائیکلیں بھی قبضے میں لی گئی ہیں۔

stories.title: Missing Teen Rescued in Australian Bush After Surviving Six Days on Crisps
stories.summary:
A 17-year-old boy named William was successfully rescued after spending six grueling days lost in the remote bushland of Victoria, Australia. Described by authorities as an absolute miracle, the teenager's survival brought a dramatic conclusion to a large-scale search operation that deployed more than one hundred rescue workers, police officers, and aircraft.

William became separated from a companion shortly after arriving at an isolated campground. Having suffered a fall down a hill that left him disoriented and unable to walk properly, he decided to stay near a creek bed rather than venture deeper into unfamiliar terrain. Lacking mobile phone reception and wearing only shorts and work boots, he managed to endure nearly a week by consuming creek water and the contents of a single packet of potato chips.

After six days of searching, an aerial rescue team spotted a small object from a helicopter and utilized thermal and high-resolution cameras to confirm his location. Rescuers found William waving from a creek bed to signal that he was alert and conscious. A rescue unit lowered him into the aircraft, subsequently reuniting him with his mother, Elizabeth Barkley, at the site.

Medical evaluations revealed that despite his prolonged exposure to the elements, William sustained only minor scratches and severe sunburn. His mother expressed profound relief, thanking the participating search teams and humorously declaring that her son would be grounded indefinitely following the harrowing ordeal.

stories.title: Askole Receives First Winter Snowfall, Transforming Gilgit-Baltistan Into Wonderland
stories.summary:
Askole, situated as the final village in Pakistan's Gilgit-Baltistan region, has experienced its first snowfall of the winter season. The high-altitude border area, known for its extreme isolation and dramatic landscapes, welcomed the precipitation following an extended dry spell and a delayed cold season.

Local residents, particularly younger community members, greeted the seasonal change with great enthusiasm. The snowfall significantly altered the appearance of the valley and surrounding mountains. This mountainous territory holds strategic importance for the country, as it houses major glaciers including Biafo, Baltoro, and Batura, which supply a substantial portion of Pakistan's freshwater reserves from outside polar regions.

The arrival of snow has stimulated local commerce and daily routines. Traditional practices have surged, including increased consumption of local qahwa tea, purchases of warm clothing, and the stockpiling of firewood. Additionally, travelers from across the nation have begun visiting Gilgit-Baltistan to witness the winter scenery, providing a much-needed boost to local hoteliers and tourism workers.

Local authorities and government agencies have finalized preparations to maintain road networks and manage potential emergencies throughout the winter months. These measures aim to ensure that both residents and incoming visitors can navigate the season without disruption, effectively launching the official winter tourism period.

stories.title: صوبائی معاملے پر تجویز سامنے آئی تو بات کریں گے، فریال تالپر
stories.summary:
پیپلز پارٹی خواتین ونگ کی صدر فریال تالپر نے لاہور میں صحافیوں سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے واضح کیا ہے کہ صوبوں کے معاملے پر جب کوئی باضابطہ آئینی تجویز یا مسودہ سامنے آئے گا تو اس پر بات چیت کی جائے گی۔

گفتگو کے دوران انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ پنجاب اور سندھ کی ترقی کا موازنہ کرنے والے لوگ سراسر غلطی پر ہیں کیونکہ سندھ کے اندر بھی ترقیاتی کام جاری ہیں اور وہاں بھی ترقی ہو رہی ہے۔

اس موقع پر سیاسی و ملکی صورتحال کے حوالے سے دیگر رہنماؤں کے بیانات بھی سامنے آئے ہیں، جن میں وفاقی وزراء اور سیاسی جماعتوں کے نمائندگان کی آراء شامل ہیں۔

ان تمام بیانات اور سیاسی سرگرمیوں سے ملک کی مجموعی سیاسی فضا اور مختلف جماعتوں کے مؤقف کی عکاسی ہوتی ہے، جو مستقبل کی پالیسیوں کے تعین میں اہم سمجھی جاتی ہیں۔

stories.title: عالمی سطح پر مائیکروسافٹ کی سروسز میں خرابی، صارفین کو مشکلات
stories.summary:
جمعرات کے روز دنیا بھر میں مائیکروسافٹ کی مختلف ڈیجیٹل سروسز میں شدید تعطل دیکھا گیا، جس کے نتیجے میں صارفین کو شدید پریشانی کا سامنا کرنا پڑا۔ متاثر ہونے والی اہم سروسز میں مائیکروسافٹ ٹیمز، آؤٹ لک اور مصنوعی ذہانت کا سافٹ ویئر کوپائلٹ شامل ہیں۔ اس تکنیکی خرابی کی وجہ سے دنیا بھر کے صارفین کے لیے ان پلیٹ فارمز تک رسائی عارضی طور پر معطل ہو گئی۔

مائیکروسافٹ نے اس واقعے کی باضابطہ تصدیق کرتے ہوئے بتایا کہ کمپنی کے انفرااسٹرکچر کے ایک حصے پر غیر معمولی دباؤ بڑھ گیا تھا جس کے باعث یہ مسائل پیدا ہوئے۔ کمپنی کے مطابق یہ خلل صارفین کی طرف سے ٹریفک میں اچانک اضافے کی وجہ سے نہیں بلکہ متعدد سرورز کے یکدم دستیاب نہ ہونے کی وجہ سے سامنے آیا، جس نے باقی کارآمد سرورز پر بوجھ بڑھا دیا۔

آؤٹیج کی نگرانی کرنے والی معروف ویب سائٹ ڈاؤن ڈیٹیکٹر کے اعداد و شمار کے مطابق، برطانیہ اور امریکا میں بڑی تعداد میں صارفین نے اس تکنیکی خرابی کی شکایات درج کروائیں۔ صرف امریکا میں آؤٹ لک سے متعلق ایک لاکھ اکیس ہزار سے زائد شکایات موصول ہوئیں، جو اس مسئلے کے بڑے پیمانے پر اثرات کی نشان دہی کرتی ہیں۔

مائیکروسافٹ کے ماہرین اس کنکشن کے مسئلے کو فوری طور پر حل کرنے کے لیے مسلسل سرگرم عمل ہیں۔ کمپنی کے مطابق سرورز کی ترتیبات میں تبدیلیاں کرنے کا تجربہ کیا جا رہا ہے تاکہ سرورز کی خودکار جانچ کے دوران سامنے آنے والی خرابیوں کو جلد از جلد ختم کیا جا سکے اور نظام کو مکمل طور پر بحال کیا جا سکے۔

stories.title: Imran Khan Urges Strict Adherence to Ideology, Says PTI Secretary General
stories.summary:
Imran Khan has instructed leaders of the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf to remain steadfast in upholding party ideology, according to PTI Secretary General Salman Akram Raja. The directive was conveyed following a three-hour legal consultation meeting at Adiala Jail between the incarcerated former prime minister, his wife Bushra Bibi, and defense attorneys Salman Safdar and Latif Khosa, which was authorized by the Islamabad High Court.

Speaking on a television program, Raja stated that Khan emphasized the importance of standing firmly by democratic principles and public welfare rather than compromising. Khan also reaffirmed his support for National Assembly Opposition Leader Mehmood Khan Achakzai and Senate Opposition Leader Allama Raja Nasir Abbas, whom he previously nominated. Furthermore, Raja noted that Khan addressed the ongoing discourse surrounding the creation of new administrative units, stressing the necessity of respecting public opinion.

Addressing speculation regarding the timing of the legal visit, Raja maintained that the discussions primarily centered on legal and health matters, although the PTI leader's blood pressure levels had recently fluctuated. Raja also discussed internal party dynamics, noting that Khan instructed him to create constructive political space while remaining loyal to fundamental principles despite minor internal dissent.

In contrast, Prime Minister’s Adviser on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah dismissed claims that the legal consultation was arranged to discuss a potential 28th Constitutional Amendment. Sanaullah asserted that the meeting was strictly a routine legal proceeding facilitated to enable lawyers to present arguments in court. The PML-N leader also emphasized the existence of strong, ongoing coordination between civilian and military leadership in the country.

stories.title: Eleven Dead After Passenger Vehicle Plunges Into Gilgit River
stories.summary:
Eleven passengers were killed and two others sustained injuries when a transport van veered off a bridge and crashed into the Yasin River within the Ghizer district of Gilgit-Baltistan. The vehicle was making its way from Gilgit toward the Yasin Valley on a Thursday evening when the driver lost control near Morkah Bridge. Local police and rescue agencies quickly mobilized to the accident site to pull victims from the water.

Emergency personnel initially recovered ten bodies, which included two women, alongside three rescued passengers, before subsequent updates confirmed the death toll had risen to 11, including an infant. Two surviving individuals were admitted to Gupis Civil Hospital for medical treatment. Officials verified that the affected passengers originated from the Yasin Valley, and a formal inquiry is currently underway to ascertain the specific factors that led to the crash.

Regional leadership responded swiftly to the disaster, with Gilgit-Baltistan Chief Minister Amjad Hussain issuing directives for comprehensive medical support and immediate transport for the injured. He urged administrative and health departments to utilize every available resource carefully and to oversee the recovery process closely. Hussain also offered his condolences to the grieving families while praying for the recovery of the survivors.

This fatal plunge adds to a troubling pattern of deadly road mishaps across the country. Recent weeks have witnessed multiple severe transit accidents, including a collision on the Hazara Motorway and another crash in Pakpattan, prompting renewed scrutiny over highway safety, driver negligence, and the condition of public transport vehicles across Pakistan's rugged terrain.

stories.title: NADRA Issues Troubleshooting Guide for Pak Identity Account Registration Errors
stories.summary:
The National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) has released official instructions for citizens experiencing technical roadblocks while trying to set up a Pak Identity account. Specifically, the guidance targets users who encounter a validation error message indicating that their Computerized National Identity Card number is already linked to a different profile.

Rather than attempting to establish a brand-new profile when this validation conflict arises, NADRA explicitly instructs applicants to utilize the platform's official account recovery process. Following the proper recovery workflow ensures that citizens can successfully reclaim access or resolve duplicate associations tied to their identity documents without violating system security rules.

For individuals requiring further technical support or personalized assistance regarding registration issues, NADRA maintains dedicated communication channels. Citizens can reach out directly by calling the official helpline at 1777 or by visiting the agency's primary web portal at www.nadra.gov.pk for detailed digital services.

This administrative update is part of NADRA's ongoing efforts to streamline digital access for citizens managing their official documentation online. By clarifying the recovery pathway for duplicate CNIC entries, the authority aims to reduce user frustration and prevent unauthorized or redundant account creation attempts across its portal.

stories.title: Bhardey Family Clarifies Ownership of Pistol Recovered from Sealed Restaurant
stories.summary:
The family of Ahmed Bhardey, a business partner of Mir Raza, has formally clarified that a firearm recovered during a Joint Investigation Team search at their North Nazimabad restaurant branch belonged to a security guard rather than Ahmed. According to the family, police conducted the search on Wednesday in the presence of relevant individuals, taking the guard's weapon into custody.

Explaining the presence of the firearm, the family noted that both branches of the restaurant utilized private security personnel deployed through a contracting firm. Similar to the Bahadurabad location, the security guard stationed at the North Nazimabad branch routinely left his service weapon on the premises at the end of a shift. Furthermore, the family emphasized that the North Nazimabad branch had remained completely closed to the public since July 29.

This statement directly counters earlier assertions from Joint Investigation Team sources, which had previously characterized the seized pistol as Ahmed Bhardey's personal weapon and sent the item for forensic examination alongside seized business records. The JIT had earlier taken action to seal the Nazimabad-area establishment as part of the broader inquiry into the Mir Raza case.

Despite the differing claims regarding the recovered pistol, Bhardey's relatives stressed that they are fully cooperating with the ongoing Joint Investigation Team inquiry. They confirmed their commitment to appearing before investigators whenever and wherever summoned to assist authorities with the case proceedings.

stories.title: Pakistani State Minister Directs SBP to Prepare Raast QR MDR Working Paper
stories.summary:
State Minister for Railways and Finance Bilal Azhar Kayani instructed the State Bank of Pakistan to formulate a working paper focusing on the proposed Raast QR Merchant Discount Rate scheme. This directive came during a high-level review meeting regarding the Cashless Pakistan initiative held at the Finance Division, building on earlier decisions made by the prime minister's Cashless Committee.

During the discussions, officials examined ways to enhance the Raast framework and improve transaction monitoring. The minister mandated that the official progress dashboard track not merely the total volume and value of digital payments, but also the exact number of unique digital account users. Furthermore, he requested an evaluation of macroeconomic indicators, such as the proportion of transactions processed through the Real-Time Gross Settlement system relative to gross domestic product.

Significant milestones under the initiative were reviewed during the meeting. Starting November 16, all payments concerning Asaan Assignment Accounts nationwide will transition to the Raast system, with relevant Drawing and Disbursing Officers already receiving training. Active merchants accepting digital payments have expanded from 0.5 million to 2.03 million. Additionally, Raast QR codes are now featured on over 45 million gas and electricity bills, and all National Database and Registration Authority centers have integrated Raast QR to accept digital service fees.

To further advance the national cashless agenda, Minister Kayani announced upcoming discussions with bank presidents and chief executives in Karachi. He emphasized the importance of tightening coordination between public and private stakeholders to ensure the ongoing success and expansion of the digital payment ecosystem across Pakistan.

stories.title: بانی پی ٹی آئی کے تمام معاملات عدالتوں سے حل ہوں گے، طارق فضل
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر ڈاکٹر طارق فضل چوہدری نے میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے دوٹوک الفاظ میں واضح کیا ہے کہ بانی پی ٹی آئی سے جڑے تمام تر معاملات کا حل عدالتوں کے ذریعے ہی ممکن ہے۔

انہوں نے بتایا کہ حکومت کی طرف سے نہ تو کوئی ڈیل کی پالیسی ہے اور نہ ہی کوئی ڈھیل دی جا رہی ہے۔ انہوں نے یہ بھی کہا کہ ایک طرف بانی پی ٹی آئی خود کو مضبوط ظاہر کرتے ہیں جبکہ دوسری طرف حکومت سے رابطوں کی باتیں کرتے ہیں۔

وفاقی وزیر کے مطابق پی ٹی آئی کے ساتھ اس وقت کسی بھی قسم کے پس پردہ یا سامنے کے رابطے نہیں ہو رہے اور اس نوعیت کی خبریں محض خواہشات کا اظہار ہیں۔

ان کا یہ بیان اس وقت سامنے آیا ہے جب سیاسی مباحثوں اور مختلف رہنماؤں کے درمیان رابطوں کے حوالے سے چہ مگوئیاں کی جا رہی تھیں، جس سے حکومت اور اپوزیشن کے درمیان تعلقات کی نوعیت واضح ہوتی ہے۔

stories.title: بیرسٹر گوہر اور محسن نقوی کے رابطے رہے ہیں، علی محمد خان
stories.summary:
پاکستان تحریک انصاف کے رہنما علی محمد خان نے ایک ٹی وی پروگرام میں گفتگو کرتے ہوئے تصدیق کی ہے کہ بیرسٹر گوہر اور وفاقی وزیر محسن نقوی کے درمیان رابطے رہے ہیں۔

انہوں نے کہا کہ بانی پی ٹی آئی سے ملاقات اس بات کی علامت ہے کہ حالات میں بہتری آ رہی ہے اور ایسے رابطے ہونے بھی چاہئیں۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ یہ ملاقاتیں کسی احتجاج یا لانگ مارچ کے دباؤ کا نتیجہ نہیں ہیں۔

پی ٹی آئی رہنما نے یاد دلایا کہ وزیراعظم نے ڈیڑھ سال کے دوران پانچ مرتبہ مذاکرات کی پیشکش کی تھی اور اگر اس وقت اپوزیشن بات چیت کا راستہ اپناتی تو یہ ملاقاتیں مہینوں پہلے ہو سکتیں تھیں۔

ان کے اس بیان سے سیاسی کشیدگی میں کمی اور فریقین کے مابین رابطوں کی بحالی کے امکانات پر اہم روشنی پڑتی ہے، جو ملکی سیاسی استحکام کے لیے ضروری مانا جاتا ہے۔

stories.title: پاکستان اور برطانیہ کے درمیان دوطرفہ تجارت میں وسعت کے امکانات
stories.summary:
برطانیہ میں پاکستان کے ہائی کمشنر ٹیپو عثمان نے بریڈفورڈ میں ویسٹ یارکشائر پاکستان ٹریڈ، انویسٹمنٹ اینڈ انوویشن سمٹ 2026 سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ پاکستان اور برطانیہ کے درمیان سالانہ تجارت کا حجم 6 ارب پاؤنڈ تک پہنچ چکا ہے۔ انہوں نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ دونوں ممالک کے مابین فن ٹیک اور ٹیکسٹائل سمیت مختلف شعبوں میں باهمی تجارت اور سرمایہ کاری بڑھانے کے وسیع مواقع موجود ہیں۔

ہائی کمشنر نے بتایا کہ پاکستانی ٹیکسٹائل کی صنعت برطانوی اداروں کے اشتراک سے جدید دھاگے، ریشے اور نئی مصنوعات تیار کرنے کی صلاحیت رکھتی ہے، اور دونوں ممالک کی کمپنیوں کو مشترکہ پیداواری منصوبے شروع کرنے چاہئیں۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ ماحول دوست پیداوار، ٹیکسٹائل اور حلال خوراک کے شعبوں میں دوطرفہ تعاون کو مزید فروغ دینے کے پُرکشش امکانات پائے جاتے ہیں۔

ٹیپو عثمان نے تقریب کے دوران اس امر کا بھی ذکر کیا کہ ویسٹ یارکشائر کے علاقے میں تقریباً আড়াই لاکھ پاکستانی نژاد افراد آباد ہیں جو زندگی کے مختلف شعبوں میں انتہائی نمایاں اور مثبت کردار ادا کر رہے ہیں۔ اس سمٹ کا مقصد دونوں ممالک کے درمیان تجارتی اور معاشی تعلقات کو مزید مستحکم کرنا ہے۔

stories.title: Punjab Tourism Department Announces 27 Vacancies With Salaries up to Rs. 950,000
stories.summary:
The Punjab Tourism, Archaeology and Museums Department has opened applications for 27 professional positions under its Strategic Management Unit project. The available roles span multiple sectors, including management, engineering, finance, information technology, media, research, tourism, and conservation.

Among the advertised posts are Team Lead, Lead Project Management, Lead Finance and Investment, Senior Civil Engineer, Legal and Regulatory Specialist, IT and Digital Transformation Expert, Tourism Investment Analyst, Data Analyst, and Heritage and Conservation Expert. Additional openings include various media roles such as content writers, graphic designers, videographers, photographers, and video editors, alongside four Research Associates and a Drone Operator position.

Compensation packages vary significantly by role, with the highest monthly salary of Rs. 950,000 designated for the Team Lead position. Lead Project Management follows at Rs. 850,000, and Lead Finance and Investment is set at Rs. 796,096. Other specialized expert roles offer between Rs. 400,000 and Rs. 450,000 per month, media positions range from Rs. 250,000 to Rs. 300,000, Research Associates will receive Rs. 180,000, and the Drone Operator role carries a monthly salary of Rs. 160,000.

Candidates must satisfy specific educational requirements, professional experience thresholds, and age criteria, and must hold a Punjab domicile. Applications must be submitted online through the Punjab Jobs Portal by the deadline of November 25, 2026, as physical submissions are not accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for subsequent assessments like tests or interviews.

stories.title: Three Terrorists Killed and Two Civilians Dead After Attack on Mastung Post
stories.summary:
Security forces successfully repelled an assault on the Kandawa Post along the N-25 highway in Balochistan's Mastung district, killing three terrorists in the ensuing operation. According to a Balochistan Police spokesperson, the attack was initiated by militants belonging to Fitna al-Hindustan, a designation used by the state for regional terrorist factions to highlight external involvement, who utilized an explosives-laden vehicle.

Despite the rapid and effective response by security personnel that neutralized three attackers, the incident resulted in tragic civilian and security casualties. Two civilians lost their lives, and at least 13 other individuals sustained injuries. Furthermore, three personnel from the Frontier Corps were wounded, and the massive explosion caused structural damage to nearby residential buildings and a local mosque.

Injured victims were promptly transferred to medical facilities for urgent treatment. Police authorities stated that the violent assault underscores the complete lack of ties between these terrorist elements and the local population of Balochistan, vowing that counter-terrorism operations will persist to safeguard public safety and regional development.

The attack occurs amid a broader security trend in the region. Recent intelligence-based operations have targeted militant cells across Balochistan, contributing to a notable 46 percent decline in terrorist attacks within the province during the month of October, as documented by the Pakistan Institute for Conflict and Security Studies.

stories.title: iPhone 18 Pro Max Emerges Victorious in Comprehensive Smartphone Battery Endurance Testing
stories.summary:
Apple’s flagship iPhone 18 Pro Max has secured the top ranking in a rigorous battery endurance assessment, outperforming 31 alternative smartphone models across a multi-phase evaluation. The testing framework measured real-world energy consumption under heavy daily conditions, including continuous media streaming, internet browsing, social media use, gaming, and phone calls.

The evaluation process consisted of two primary stages lasting nearly four hours in total. The first phase tested battery depletion during three hours of continuous Wi-Fi video streaming at maximum screen brightness. The second phase averaged remaining battery percentages across mixed-use tasks conducted over 45-minute intervals. The iPhone 18 Pro Max and Apple's new foldable device, the iPhone Duo, both dominated the mixed-use category by retaining 99 percent of their battery capacity, while Google's Pixel 11 Pro XL followed closely at 97 percent.

Industry analysts attribute the superior endurance of the iPhone 18 Pro Max to a combination of physical hardware enhancements and software optimizations. The device features a larger battery capacity than preceding models, alongside the energy-efficient performance of the A20 Pro chip and built-in power-saving capabilities within iOS. Additionally, the standard iPhone 18 Pro excelled in the continuous video streaming evaluation by retaining 94 percent of its charge.

The findings emphasize that seamless hardware and software integration remains critical for achieving all-day power efficiency in modern mobile devices. For consumers seeking extended battery performance without purchasing top-tier flagship hardware, the analysis also highlighted options such as the iPhone 17 and Motorola's mid-tier Edge series as reliable daily alternatives.

stories.title: Joint Investigation Team Seals Karachi Restaurant Linked to Mir Raza Case Partner
stories.summary:
The Joint Investigation Team probing the murder of Mir Raza Ali in Karachi has taken action by sealing a restaurant owned by Ahmed Bhardey, a business partner of Mir Raza, located in the Nazimabad area. During the search of the establishment, authorities recovered a personal pistol belonging to Bhardey, which has been forwarded for forensic examination alongside the seizure of the restaurant's records.

This development follows the conclusion of the JIT's inaugural five-hour meeting, chaired by DIG Irfan Baloch with security agency representatives, where a detailed statement from the victim's father was formally recorded. Advocate Jibran Nasir, representing the family, participated in the discussions and advocated for a rigorous examination into the conduct of the Ferozabad Police Station SHO and other implicated individuals.

Speaking to the press after the session, Advocate Nasir confirmed that all family concerns were formally submitted and noted that formal letters would be dispatched to the Establishment Division and the Chief Minister of Sindh. He also voiced dissatisfaction regarding a separate inquiry committee investigating specific police officers, noting that two weeks have passed without visible progress or the removal of the targeted personnel.

The ongoing investigation continues to review the Judicial Commission's report and accumulated evidence. Legal representatives have expressed optimism that substantial headway in the case will be achieved within the upcoming two weeks as the inquiry deepens.

stories.title: وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی کی نواب شاہ میں صدر آصف زرداری سے ملاقات
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی نے نواب شاہ میں صدر مملکت آصف علی زرداری سے ملاقات کی ہے، جو ذرائع کے مطابق تقریباً ایک گھنٹہ تک جاری رہی۔

اس ملاقات کے دوران دونوں رہنماؤں کے مابین اہم سیاسی امور، ملک کی مجموعی سیکیورٹی صورتحال اور نئے صوبوں کے قیام کے حوالے سے تفصیلی تبادلہ خیال کیا گیا۔

ملاقات کے فوری بعد وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی زرداری ہاؤس سے روانہ ہو کر ایئرپورٹ کی طرف چلے گئے جہاں سے وہ اپنے اگلے سفر کے لیے روانہ ہوئے۔

واضح رہے کہ صدر آصف علی زرداری گزشتہ دس روز سے سندھ میں ہی قیام پذیر ہیں اور اس دوران انہوں نے ٹھٹہ، سجاول اور ٹنڈو الہ یار کے اضلاع کے دورے بھی کیے ہیں۔

stories.title: میرپورخاص میں ٹرک کی ٹکر سے ایک ہی خاندان کے 4 افراد جاں بحق
stories.summary:
سندھ کے علاقے میرپورخاص میں سندھڑی کے قریب پھلاڈیوں اور تگوسر روڈ پر ایک دلخراش ٹریفک حادثہ پیش آیا ہے۔ تیز رفتار ٹرک نے موٹر سائیکل کو ٹکر مار دی جس کے نتیجے میں موٹر سائیکل پر سوار ایک ہی خاندان کے چار افراد موقع پر ہی جاں بحق ہو گئے۔

ریسکیو حکام کی جانب سے فراہم کردہ ابتدائی معلومات کے مطابق اس حادثے میں جان کی بازی ہارنے والوں میں دو کمسن بچے بھی شامل ہیں۔ حادثے کے فوری بعد ٹرک کا ڈرائیور موقع سے فرار ہونے میں کامیاب ہو گیا جبکہ لاشوں کو ضروری کارروائی کے لیے منتقل کر دیا گیا۔

اس نوعیت کے المناک سڑک حادثات سے علاقہ مکینوں میں گہرے رنج و غم کی لہر دوڑ گئی ہے۔ مقامی انتظامیہ اور ٹریفک پولیس کی جانب سے مفرور ڈرائیور کی تلاش کے لیے کوششیں شروع کر دی گئی ہیں تاکہ قانون کے مطابق کارروائی عمل میں لائی جا سکے۔

عوام اور مسافروں کی جانب سے اس روڈ پر ٹریفک کے قوانین کی سختی سے پابندی کرانے اور تیز رفتاری پر قابو پانے کا مطالبہ کیا جا رہا ہے۔ اس حادثے نے ایک بار پھر شاہراہوں پر حفاظتی اقدامات اور لاپرواہ ڈرائیونگ کے تدارک کی شدید ضرورت کو اجاگر کیا ہے۔

stories.title: Cultural Pressure of 'Log Kya Kaheinge' Drives Pakistani Household Debt
stories.summary:
In Pakistan, the prevalent cultural phrase “log kya kaheinge,” translating to what will people say, heavily dictates economic decisions and household spending habits. Authored by Haddiqua Siddiqui, an analysis highlights how this social anxiety compels citizens to buy, spend, and live in ways that project high social standing rather than fulfilling practical needs.

Major life events, particularly weddings, demonstrate this phenomenon clearly. Families often feel obligated to spend millions of rupees on venues, guest lists, and decorations not out of personal desire, but to avoid negative societal judgment. This pressure extends beyond ceremonies into choices regarding vehicles, residences, schooling, and even career paths, where individuals frequently pursue prestigious professions like medicine or law to gain community approval instead of following personal interests.

The financial repercussions of such status-driven consumption are substantial. Money directed toward public image represents a significant opportunity cost, draining funds that could otherwise go toward savings, homeownership, education, or essential investments. Furthermore, modern technology has intensified these expectations; social media constantly exposes users to curated depictions of lavish lifestyles, fueling aspirational inflation where standard consumption feels inadequate.

Conversely, the same cultural constraint can restrict spending on unconventional items that households genuinely value, while trapping individuals in unfulfilling jobs or relationships to dodge public criticism. Although social reputation holds genuine value, economists argue that treating community opinion as an invisible line item in household budgets often creates unnecessary financial distress. Ultimately, experts suggest questioning whether major expenses would still be chosen if nobody else were watching.

stories.title: Pakistan State Oil and Kuwait Petroleum Corporation Extend Fuel Supply Deal
stories.summary:
Pakistan State Oil (PSO) and Kuwait Petroleum Corporation (KPC) have formally agreed to sustain the ongoing supply of diesel and jet fuel to Pakistan while simultaneously broadening bilateral energy collaboration. The consensus was reached during an official visit to Kuwait by a PSO delegation led by Chief Executive Officer Jawwad Ahmed Cheema, who engaged in strategic discussions with senior KPC leadership.

During the meetings, both organizations resolved to refine the terms of existing supply contracts to reflect current market dynamics, thereby reinforcing a robust fifty-year energy partnership. The dialogue encompassed prospective joint ventures across petroleum provisioning, shipping, storage infrastructure, refining, lubricants, and direct investments aimed at bolstering regional energy security and long-term economic expansion.

As part of the agreement, KPC will utilize Pakistan's port and storage facilities under the Pakistani government’s newly revised Customs Bonded Storage Policy. This arrangement permits imported petroleum products to serve the domestic market while also facilitating re-exports to neighboring regional markets. Implementation formalities are slated for finalization shortly through coordination with relevant national institutions.

Additionally, the delegates evaluated commercial opportunities regarding base oil supplies, lubricant marketing, and prospective capital investments by KPC within Pakistan's broader energy sector. Chief Executive Jawwad Ahmed Cheema emphasized that Kuwait's involvement in local storage and port infrastructure creates vital avenues for enhancing regional trade, attracting foreign investment, and securing energy provisions for the future.

stories.title: Pakistan Government Decreases Petrol and Diesel Prices Across the Country
stories.summary:
The Pakistan government has lowered the cost of petrol and high-speed diesel, with the new rates taking effect on Friday, November 13, 2026. According to an official press release from the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority, petrol saw a decrease of Rs3 to reach Rs332 per litre, while high-speed diesel dropped by Rs4 to settle at Rs360 per litre. These pricing adjustments are calculated in accordance with the official petroleum products pricing mechanism approved by the federal administration.

This recent announcement follows another downward revision made a day prior, when petrol was lowered to Rs335 and high-speed diesel to Rs364 per litre. The adjustment comes amid fluctuating global oil markets where crude prices experienced upward movement after initial losses due to ongoing geopolitical tensions in Russia and the Middle East. At the same time, Brent futures traded higher at $93.40 a barrel and US West Texas Intermediate crude inched up to $86.54, though both benchmarks remained on track for a weekly decline.

The regulatory changes affect daily fuel commerce as the authorities continue to monitor international pricing trends. The ongoing adjustments in local petroleum product values are closely tied to these broader global energy market developments, impacting domestic consumers and fuel expenditures across the nation as pricing mechanisms respond to shifting supply and geopolitical pressures.

stories.title: Colette Kress Appointed Interim CEO of Nvidia Following Jensen Huang's Ousting
stories.summary:
Nvidia finance chief Colette Kress has been designated as the interim chief executive officer of the artificial intelligence chip giant. The board of directors elevated Kress to the top position following the ousting of co-founder and former CEO Jensen Huang amid reports of two extramarital affairs, including one involving a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. Kress brings a strong financial background to her new role, having served as executive vice president and chief financial officer since joining Nvidia in September 2013.

During her tenure at the company, Nvidia experienced massive revenue growth, rising from $4.13 billion in her starting fiscal year to $215.9 billion in fiscal 2026. Her extensive career in the technology sector includes financial leadership roles at Texas Instruments, an eight-year tenure at Microsoft where she became CFO of the Server and Tools division in 2006, and a stint at Cisco starting in 2010. She holds a bachelor of science degree in finance from the University of Arizona and a master of business administration degree from Southern Methodist University.

Kress is recognized among corporate leaders, ranking No. 32 on Forbes' 2026 list of America's richest self-made women. Her equity holdings in the chipmaker were valued at approximately $750 million as of the latest market close. Executive officers at Nvidia are employed at will without individual employment or severance agreements, and Kress's compensation includes restricted stock units that vest over a four-year period.

stories.title: Pakistan Lowers Petrol and Diesel Rates for the Eighth Consecutive Time
stories.summary:
The Pakistani government has announced a reduction in fuel costs for the eighth consecutive time, lowering petrol by Rs3 and high-speed diesel by Rs4 per litre. Effective November 13, petrol will retail at Rs332 per litre and high-speed diesel will cost Rs360 per litre. The state continues to levy heavy taxes and duties, collecting Rs114 per litre on petrol and Rs100 per litre on diesel. Under a recent arrangement, oil refineries are contributing to the petroleum levy by bearing a cumulative impact of Rs15 billion to facilitate consumer price reductions.

The revision follows previous emergency actions, including the Prime Minister's Fuel Relief Scheme launched in September to support owners of motorcycles, rickshaws, and vehicles up to 800cc. Amid ongoing Middle East conflicts and fluctuating international markets, the government also reintroduced austerity measures, mandating that markets close by 9 PM and cutting fuel allocations for official vehicles by 50 percent for three months. Officials noted that petrol and high-speed diesel are major revenue earners with monthly sales reaching up to 800,000 tonnes.

The changes in fuel prices directly affect middle and lower-middle classes who rely on petrol for private transport and small vehicles, as well as the broader public impacted by diesel costs in heavy transport and power generation. International oil prices recently showed slight recovery amid geopolitical tensions in Russia and the Middle East, with Brent futures rising to $93.40 a barrel and US West Texas Intermediate reaching $86.54, even as both contracts headed for weekly losses.

stories.title: ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ کا ایران کے خلاف جنگ جیتنے کا دعویٰ
stories.summary:
امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ نے ایک ٹی وی انٹرویو میں دعویٰ کیا ہے کہ امریکا اس وقت ایران کے خلاف جنگ جیتنے کے آخری مراحل میں ہے اور وہ جب چاہیں ایران کے خلاف جنگ جیت سکتے ہیں۔ انہوں نے خبردار کیا کہ ضرورت پڑنے پر فوری فوجی کارروائی سے بھی گریز نہیں کیا جائے گا اور ایران کے خلاف طاقت استعمال کرنے میں انہیں کوئی ہچکچاہٹ نہیں ہوگی۔

صدر ٹرمپ نے دعویٰ کیا کہ امریکا نے ایران کو بالکل بے اثر کر دیا ہے کیونکہ ایرانی معیشت تباہ ہو چکی ہے، مہنگائی کی شرح 301 فیصد تک پہنچ گئی ہے اور ایرانی فوجیوں کو تنخواہیں تک ادا نہیں کی جا رہی ہیں۔ انہوں نے یہ بھی کہا کہ وہ کیوبا کے خلاف ایک مختصر فوجی کارروائی پر غور کر رہے ہیں اور صدارت کا منصب چھوڑنے سے پہلے کیوبا کے اس معاملے کو حل کرنا چاہتے ہیں۔

اس کے علاوہ، ٹرمپ نے اسرائیل میں اپنی مقبولیت 99 فیصد ہونے کا دعویٰ کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ وہ خود اسرائیل جا کر وہاں کے وزیراعظم بھی بن سکتے ہیں۔ دریں اثنا، انہوں نے امریکی نائب صدر جے ڈی وینس کو یہ خصوصی ہدایت دی ہے کہ وہ ایران سے مذاکرات کی فکر چھوڑ کر اپنی تمام تر توجہ ڈیموکریٹس کے زیر انتظام شہروں اور ریاستوں میں مبینہ جرائم اور بدعنوانی کے معاملات پر مرکوز کریں۔

stories.title: OGRA Notifies Reduced Fuel Prices While Petroleum Dealers Demand Refinery Audit
stories.summary:
The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority has issued a formal notification detailing reductions in fuel prices across the country. According to the announcement, the cost of petrol decreased by Rs3 to rest at Rs332 per litre, while diesel dropped by Rs4 to reach Rs360 per litre, with the revised rates coming into effect on November 13. These pricing shifts occur alongside broader discussions among industry stakeholders regarding the financial margins of energy companies.

Concurrently, petroleum dealers in Karachi held an emergency meeting to address refinery profits and consumer relief, calling for a transparent forensic audit of all oil refineries. Industry representatives, including Malik Khuda Bakhsh and Anwar Kamal, alleged that refineries earned excessive profits—equivalent to a full year's earnings in just three months—and asserted that a thorough examination of financial records could reveal scope for reducing petrol prices by Rs40 to Rs50 per litre. The dealers argued that a detailed audit would substantiate their claims and prevent unnecessary financial burdens on the public.

In addition to fuel pricing updates, the National Database and Registration Authority released guidance for citizens experiencing registration issues with Pak Identity accounts. The advisory addresses validation errors encountered by users when their computerised national identity card numbers are already linked to existing accounts, providing steps to resolve authentication challenges during the digital registration process.

stories.title: Interior Minister Proposes Public Referendum on Establishing New Provinces
stories.summary:
Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi suggested holding a referendum to determine public consensus regarding the establishment of new administrative provinces. Speaking at a press conference at the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) office in Lahore, the minister explained that the public should decide the issue, adding that the proposal should be abandoned if citizens disagree, but carried out if they support it. This discussion follows ongoing debates concerning administrative restructuring, decentralization, and governance challenges, which gained momentum in July 2026 after the minister initially called for additional administrative units.

Addressing broader political concerns, Naqvi stated that all political factions, including the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf, possess legal rights and will receive any relief granted by the courts. He dismissed rumors concerning extraordinary political shifts and rejected claims of rifts among governing allies, emphasizing that the Pakistan Peoples Party, Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz, and other partners remain united and will reach major decisions through consensus.

Turning to law enforcement and institutional matters, the minister acknowledged that corruption is widespread and requires evidence-backed responses. He revealed that the NCCIA arrested a Grade-17 government official and is currently investigating five significant cases involving public sector institutions. Additionally, Naqvi announced that individuals will soon be able to submit cybercrime complaints via NADRA's Pak ID platform to ensure digital tracking.

Highlighting resource limitations, Naqvi noted that the NCCIA has just 61 staff members serving a population of 140 million and stated that he will brief the prime minister next week regarding agency requirements. Despite these constraints, the minister shared that authorities busted a major fraudulent network that helped about 5,000 citizens improperly pass international educational institution examinations. Furthermore, the National Centre for Missing and Child Abuse detained 15 people in Punjab over the prior month for child exploitation and pornographic distribution linked to international websites, alongside the resolution of FBI-related and call center cases.

stories.title: Mohsin Naqvi Travels to Nawabshah to Meet President Asif Ali Zardari
stories.summary:
Federal Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi traveled to Nawabshah, heading directly to Zardari House from the airport to meet with President Asif Ali Zardari. The scheduled discussion involved briefing the president on critical national matters, notably the establishment of new administrative provinces.

During his discussions, Naqvi suggested conducting a public referendum regarding the formation of new provinces, emphasizing that the general population's perspective must be honored. He remarked that the broader governance framework is poised for a significant reset. Addressing remarks made by Bilawal Bhutto Zardari concerning a political reset, Naqvi stated that they share a similar viewpoint and stressed that the Pakistan Peoples Party, the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz, and other political groups hold equal importance. He maintained that no actions will be pursued without achieving a broad consensus among all parties.

The interior minister additionally addressed the issue of corruption within Pakistan, asserting that individuals who deny its existence must confront the reality and work toward its eradication. He emphasized that resolving this challenge is a shared obligation requiring participation from every stakeholder in the country.

In response to inquiries regarding jailed Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf founder Imran Khan, Naqvi assured that legal accommodations will remain available to him. He refuted rumors regarding impending political shifts, clarifying that official policies and interactions concerning PTI have not altered.

stories.title: ایف بی آر افسران کے ٹیسٹ نتائج: بیشتر افسران فیصلے کی اہلیت نہیں رکھتے
stories.summary:
فیڈرل بورڈ آف ریونیو (ایف بی آر) کے افسران کی پیشہ ورانہ صلاحیتوں کو جانچنے کے لیے ایک امتحان لیا گیا جس کے نتائج نے اہم حقائق کو بے نقاب کیا ہے۔ کراچی میں ان لینڈ ریونیو کے محکمے میں گریڈ 17 اور اس سے اوپر کے افسران کے لیے سیلز ٹیکس اور انکم ٹیکس کے مضامین کے یہ امتحانات منعقد کیے گئے تھے۔

ٹیسٹ کے نتائج سے انکشاف ہوا ہے کہ امتحان دینے والے زیادہ تر افسران نوٹس کا مسودہ تیار کرنے اور قانون کی معمولی غلطیوں کو پہچاننے کی صلاحیت تو رکھتے ہیں، لیکن ان میں قانون کو گہرائی سے سمجھ کر کیس کا درست فیصلہ کرنے کی اہلیت نہیں پائی جاتی۔
